title.raw: 卷10 孝莊紀 Volume 10 Annals: Xiaozhuang (Emperor Xiaozhuang)

sentences.zh: 孝莊皇帝，諱子攸，彭城王勰之第三子，母曰李妃。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaozhuang bore the taboo name Ziyou; he was the third son of Prince of Pengcheng Rong; his mother was Consort Li.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaozhuang bore the taboo name Ziyou. He was the third son of Prince of Pengcheng Rong; his mother was Consort Li.

sentences.zh: 肅宗初，以勰有魯陽翼衞之勳，封武城縣開國公。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Suzong's reign, because Rong had merit in guarding and supporting at Luyang, he was enfeoffed as Duke of Wucheng, state-founding.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Suzong's reign, because Rong had merit guarding and supporting at Luyang, Ziyou was enfeoffed as state-founding Duke of Wucheng.

sentences.zh: 幼侍肅宗書於禁內。

translations.literal: In youth he attended Suzong in study within the forbidden quarters.
translations.idiomatic: As a boy he studied with Suzong inside the palace.

sentences.zh: 及長，風神秀慧，姿貌甚美。

translations.literal: When grown, his spirit and bearing were elegant and wise, and his appearance very handsome.
translations.idiomatic: When he came of age his bearing was elegant and keen, and his looks strikingly fine.

sentences.zh: 拜中書侍郎、城門校尉、兼給事黃門侍郎，雅為肅宗所親待，長直禁中。

translations.literal: He was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat, colonel of the city gates, and concurrently Attendant at the Yellow Gate; he was greatly favored and trusted by Suzong and held long duty in the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: He was made vice director of the secretariat, colonel of the city gates, and concurrently attendant at the yellow gate; Suzong favored and trusted him deeply, and he kept long watches in the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 遷散騎常侍、御史中尉。

translations.literal: He was transferred to scattered cavalier attendant and censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to scattered cavalier attendant and censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 孝昌二年八月，進封長樂王。

translations.literal: Eighth month of the second year of Xiaochang: he was advanced to Prince of Changle.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the second year of Xiaochang he was advanced to prince of Changle.

sentences.zh: 轉侍中、中軍將軍。

translations.literal: He was transferred to attendant-in-ordinary and general of the central army.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to attendant-in-ordinary and general of the central army.

sentences.zh: 三年十月，以兄彭城王劭事，轉為衞將軍、左光祿大夫、中書監，實見出也。

translations.literal: Tenth month of the third year: because of the affair of his elder brother Prince of Pengcheng Xu, he was transferred to general of the guard, grand master of splendid carriages with golden seal and purple cord, and director of the secretariat—in truth he was being sent out.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the third year, because of his elder brother Prince of Pengcheng Xu, he was transferred to general of the guard, grand master of splendid carriages with golden seal and purple cord, and director of the secretariat—a real demotion in all but name.

sentences.zh: 及武泰元年春二月，肅宗崩，大都督尒朱榮將向京師，謀欲廢立。

translations.literal: When spring of the second month of the first year of Wutai came, Suzong died; Grand Commander Erzhu Rong was marching on the capital, plotting to depose and install.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the second month of the first year of Wutai, Suzong died. Grand Commander Erzhu Rong was marching on the capital with plans to depose and enthrone.

sentences.zh: 以帝家有忠勳，且兼民望，陰與帝通，榮乃率眾來赴。

translations.literal: Because the imperial house had loyal merit and he also enjoyed the people's regard, Rong secretly communicated with him; Rong then led his host to answer the summons.
translations.idiomatic: Because the house had shown loyal merit and he enjoyed popular regard, Rong secretly treated with him; Rong then led his troops to answer the call.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙申，帝與兄弟夜北渡河；

translations.literal: Fourth month, day bingchen: the Emperor and his brothers crossed the Yellow River north by night;
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day in the fourth month the emperor and his brothers crossed the Yellow River northward by night;

sentences.zh: 丁酉，會榮於河陽。

translations.literal: day dingyou: he met Rong at Heyin.
translations.idiomatic: on dingyou day he met Rong at Heyin.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，南濟河，即帝位。

translations.literal: day wuxu: he crossed the river south and took the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day he crossed south and took the throne.

sentences.zh: 以兄彭城王劭為無上王，弟霸城公子正為始平王。

translations.literal: His elder brother Prince of Pengcheng Xu was made Prince Without Superior; his younger brother Zizheng, son of Prince of Bacheng, was made Prince of Shiping.
translations.idiomatic: His elder brother Prince of Pengcheng Xu was made prince without superior; his younger brother Zizheng, son of Prince of Bacheng, was made prince of Shiping.

sentences.zh: 以榮為使持節、侍中、都督中外諸軍事、大將軍、尚書令、領軍將軍、領左右，封太原王。

translations.literal: Rong was made bearer of the staff of authority, attendant-in-ordinary, commander of all armies at home and abroad, grand general, director of the secretariat, general of the garrison, and commander of the left and right guards; he was enfeoffed as Prince of Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Rong was made bearer of the staff of authority, attendant-in-ordinary, commander of all armies at home and abroad, grand general, director of the secretariat, general of the garrison, and commander of the left and right guards, and enfeoffed as Prince of Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 己亥，百僚相率，有司奉璽紱，備法駕，奉迎於河梁。

translations.literal: day jihai: the hundred officials in succession, the relevant offices bearing the seal and cord, with the full imperial equipage, welcomed him at the He Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the hundred officials in succession, the relevant offices bearing seal and cord and full imperial equipage, welcomed him at the He Bridge.

sentences.zh: 庚子，車駕巡河，西至陶渚。

translations.literal: day gengzi: the imperial carriage toured the river, west to Taozhu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day the imperial carriage toured the river as far west as Taozhu.

sentences.zh: 榮以兵權在己，遂有異志，乃害靈太后及幼主，次害無上王劭、始平王子正，又害丞相高陽王雍、司空公元欽、儀同三司元恒芝、儀同三司東平王略、廣平王悌、常山王巶、北平王超、任城王彝、趙郡王毓、[1]中山王叔仁、齊郡王溫，公卿已下二千餘人。

translations.literal: Rong, with military power in his own hands, then harbored a different intent; he killed Empress Dowager Hu and the young sovereign, next killed Prince Without Superior Xu and Prince of Shiping Zizheng, and also killed Chancellor Prince of Gaoyang Yong, Minister of Works Yuan Qin, Palace Attendant of the Third Rank Yuan Hengzhi, Palace Attendant of the Third Rank Prince of Dongping Lue, Prince of Guangping Ti, Prince of Changshan Zhao, Prince of Beiping Chao, Prince of Rencheng Yi, Prince of Zhao Jun Yu, [1] Prince of Zhongshan Shuren, Prince of Qi Commandery Wen, and more than two thousand persons from dukes and ministers downward.
translations.idiomatic: With military power in his own hands Rong then turned traitor: he slew Empress Dowager Hu and the young emperor, then Prince Without Superior Xu and Prince of Shiping Zizheng, then Chancellor Prince of Gaoyang Yong, Minister of Works Yuan Qin, two palace attendants of the third rank—Yuan Hengzhi and Prince of Dongping Lue—and Princes of Guangping, Changshan, Beiping, Rencheng, Zhao, [1] Zhongshan, and Qi Commandery, with more than two thousand from dukes and ministers downward.

sentences.zh: 列騎衞帝，遷於便幕。

translations.literal: Cavalry in ranks guarded the Emperor and moved him to a field pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: Columns of cavalry guarded the emperor and moved him to a field pavilion.

sentences.zh: 既而榮悔，稽顙謝罪。

translations.literal: Before long Rong repented and knocked his forehead to the ground in confession.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Rong repented and knocked his forehead to the earth in confession.

sentences.zh: 語在榮傳。

translations.literal: The account is in Rong's biography.
translations.idiomatic: The account is in Rong's biography.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，太原王尒朱榮上表，請追諡無上王為皇帝。

translations.literal: day renyin: Prince of Taiyuan Erzhu Rong submitted a memorial asking that Prince Without Superior be posthumously titled emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Prince of Taiyuan Erzhu Rong memorialized asking that Prince Without Superior be posthumously titled emperor.

sentences.zh: 餘死於河陰者，諸王、刺史贈三司，三品者令僕，五品者刺史，七品以下及民郡、鎮。

translations.literal: The rest who died at Heyin: princes and regional inspectors were posthumously given the third rank; third-rank officials were given the rank of director; fifth-rank officials were given regional inspector; seventh rank and below were given commandery and garrison posts.
translations.idiomatic: For the rest who died at Heyin: princes and regional inspectors were posthumously given third rank; third-rank officials were given director; fifth-rank, regional inspector; seventh rank and below, commandery and garrison posts.

sentences.zh: 諸死者子孫，聽立後，授封爵。

translations.literal: Descendants of the dead were permitted to establish heirs and were granted titles and fiefs.
translations.idiomatic: Descendants of the dead were allowed to establish heirs and were granted titles and fiefs.

sentences.zh: 詔從之。

translations.literal: An edict approved it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以前太尉公、江陽王繼為太師、司州牧；

translations.literal: day guimao: the former Minister of Works, Prince of Jiangyang Ji, was made Grand Preceptor and governor of Sizhou;
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the former minister of works, Prince of Jiangyang Ji, was made grand preceptor and governor of Sizhou;

sentences.zh: 驃騎大將軍、開府、儀同三司、相州刺史、北海王顥為太傅、開府，仍刺史；

translations.literal: Grand General of Agile Cavalry, commissioner with credentials, Palace Attendant of the Third Rank, regional inspector of Xiangzhou, Prince of Beihai Hao, was made Grand Tutor and commissioner with credentials, and still regional inspector;
translations.idiomatic: Hao, grand general of agile cavalry, commissioner with credentials, palace attendant of the third rank, regional inspector of Xiang, was made grand tutor and commissioner with credentials, and remained regional inspector;

sentences.zh: 平東將軍、光祿大夫、清淵縣開國侯李延寔為太保，進封陽平王，尋轉太傅；

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the East, grand master of splendid carriages, Marquis of Qingyuan, state-founding, Li Yanshi, was made Grand Guardian, advanced to Prince of Yangping, and soon transferred to Grand Tutor;
translations.idiomatic: Li Yanshi, general who pacifies the east, grand master of splendid carriages, and state-founding Marquis of Qingyuan, was made grand guardian, advanced to prince of Yangping, and soon transferred to grand tutor;

sentences.zh: 安南將軍、并州刺史元天穆為太尉公，封上黨王；

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the South, regional inspector of Bingzhou, Yuan Tianmu, was made Minister of Works and enfeoffed as Prince of Shangdang;
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Tianmu, general who pacifies the south and regional inspector of Bing, was made minister of works and enfeoffed Prince of Shangdang;

sentences.zh: 侍中、車騎大將軍、儀同三司楊椿為司徒公；

translations.literal: Attendant-in-ordinary, Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Palace Attendant of the Third Rank Yang Chun, was made Minister over the Masses;
translations.idiomatic: Yang Chun, attendant-in-ordinary, grand general of chariots and cavalry, and palace attendant of the third rank, was made minister over the masses;

sentences.zh: 車騎大將軍、儀同三司、頓丘郡開國公穆紹為司空公，領尚書令，進爵為王；

translations.literal: Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Palace Attendant of the Third Rank, state-founding Duke of Dunqiu Mu Shao, was made Minister of Works, held additionally Director of the Secretariat, and advanced in rank to prince;
translations.idiomatic: Mu Shao, grand general of chariots and cavalry, palace attendant of the third rank, and state-founding Duke of Dunqiu, was made minister of works, held additionally director of the secretariat, and advanced to prince;

sentences.zh: 使持節、車騎大將軍、雍州刺史、上黨公長孫稚為驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，進爵為王，尋改封馮翊王；

translations.literal: Bearer of the staff of authority, Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, regional inspector of Yongzhou, Duke of Shangdang Changsun Zhi, was made Grand General of Agile Cavalry, commissioner with credentials of the third rank, advanced in rank to prince, and soon re-enfeoffed as Prince of Fengyi;
translations.idiomatic: Changsun Zhi, bearer of the staff, grand general of chariots and cavalry, regional inspector of Yong, and Duke of Shangdang, was made grand general of agile cavalry with credentials of the third rank, advanced to prince, and soon re-enfeoffed Prince of Fengyi;

sentences.zh: 中軍將軍、殿中尚書元諶為儀同三司、尚書左僕射，封魏郡王；

translations.literal: General of the central army, Director of the Palace Secretariat Yuan Chen, was made Palace Attendant of the Third Rank and Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, and enfeoffed as Prince of Wei Commandery;
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Chen, general of the central army and director of the palace secretariat, was made palace attendant of the third rank and left vice director of the secretariat, and enfeoffed Prince of Wei Commandery;

sentences.zh: 中軍將軍、給事黃門侍郎元頊為東海王；

translations.literal: General of the central army, Attendant at the Yellow Gate Yuan Xu, was made Prince of the Eastern Sea;
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Xu, general of the central army and attendant at the yellow gate, was made prince of the Eastern Sea;

sentences.zh: 金紫光祿大夫、廣陵王恭為儀同三司。

translations.literal: Grand Master of Splendid Carriages with Golden Seal and Purple Cord, Prince of Guangling Gong, was made Palace Attendant of the Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Gong, grand master of splendid carriages with golden seal and purple cord and Prince of Guangling, was made palace attendant of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，追復故廣陽王淵、故樂安王鑒爵。

translations.literal: day jiachen: the former titles of the late Prince of Guangyang Yuan and the late Prince of Le'an Jian were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the former titles of the late Prince of Guangyang Yuan and Prince of Le'an Jian were restored.

sentences.zh: 通直散騎常侍、敷城王坦為咸陽王，諫議大夫元貴平為東萊王，直閣將軍元肅為魯郡王，祕書郎中元曄為長廣王，馮翊郡開國公源紹景復先爵隴西王，扶風郡開國公馮冏、東郡公陸子彰、北平公長孫悅並復其先王爵，以北平王超還復為安定王。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant of Regular Attendance, Prince of Fucheng Tan, was made Prince of Xianyang; Remonstrator and Critic Yuan Guiping was made Prince of Donglai; Direct Palace Attendant Yuan Su was made Prince of Lu Commandery; Secretariat Gentleman Yuan Ye was made Prince of Changgang; state-founding Duke of Fengyi Yuan Shaojing had his former title of Prince of Longxi restored; state-founding Dukes of Fufeng Feng Tong, Dong Commandery Lu Zizhang, and Beiping Changsun Yue all had their former princely titles restored; because Prince of Beiping Chao was returned, he was again made Prince of Anding.
translations.idiomatic: Tan, palace attendant of regular attendance and Prince of Fucheng, was made Prince of Xianyang; remonstrator Yuan Guiping, Prince of Donglai; direct palace attendant Yuan Su, Prince of Lu; secretariat gentleman Yuan Ye, Prince of Changgang; Yuan Shaojing, state-founding Duke of Fengyi, had his former title Prince of Longxi restored; Feng Tong of Fufeng, Lu Zizhang of Dong, and Changsun Yue of Beiping all had former princely titles restored; Prince of Beiping Chao was again made Prince of Anding.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔內外解嚴。

translations.literal: day dingwei: an edict lifted martial law within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day an edict lifted martial law within and without.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，封大將軍尒朱榮次子叉羅為梁郡王。

translations.literal: day gengxu: Rong's second son Chaluo, grand general, was enfeoffed as Prince of Liang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Chaluo, second son of Grand General Erzhu Rong, was enfeoffed Prince of Liang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 詔蠕蠕主阿那瓌贊拜不名，上書不稱臣。

translations.literal: An edict granted the Rouran ruler Anagui the privilege of bowing without being named and of submitting documents without styling himself subject.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted the Rouran ruler Anagui bowing without being named and memorials without styling himself subject.

sentences.zh: 是月，汝南王悅、北海王顥、臨淮王彧前後奔蕭衍，郢州刺史元願達據城南叛。

translations.literal: That month Prince of Runan Yue, Prince of Beihai Hao, and Prince of Huaiyin Yu in succession fled to Xiao Yan; Regional Inspector of Yingzhou Yuan Yuanda held the south of the city in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: That month Princes of Runan, Beihai, and Huaiyin fled in succession to Xiao Yan; Yuan Yuanda, regional inspector of Ying, held the south of the city in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 五月丁巳朔，加大將軍尒朱榮北道大行臺。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingsi, new moon: Grand General Erzhu Rong was given the additional title of Grand Mobile Circuit of the Northern Route.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, the new moon of the fifth month, Grand General Erzhu Rong was given the additional title of grand mobile circuit of the northern route.

sentences.zh: 以尚書右僕射元羅為東道大使，征東將軍、光祿勳元欣副之，巡方黜陟，先行後聞。

translations.literal: Right Vice Director of the Secretariat Yuan Luo was made envoy of the eastern circuit; General Who Campaigns East Yuan Xin was made his deputy; they toured the regions for promotion and demotion, acting first and reporting afterward.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Luo, right vice director of the secretariat, was made envoy of the eastern circuit; Yuan Xin, general who campaigns east, was deputy; they toured the regions for promotion and demotion, acting first and reporting afterward.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，大將軍尒朱榮還晉陽，帝餞於邙陰。

translations.literal: day xinyou: Grand General Erzhu Rong returned to Jinyang; the Emperor saw him off on the north slope of Mount Mang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Grand General Erzhu Rong returned to Jinyang; the emperor saw him off on the north slope of Mount Mang.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔曰：「自孝昌之季，法令昏泯，懷忠守素，擁隔莫申，深怨宿憾，控告靡所。

translations.literal: day bingyin: an edict said: "Since the late Xiaochang era laws and orders have grown dim; those who kept faith and plain integrity found no way to declare themselves; long-held grievances had nowhere to plead.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day an edict said: "Since the late Xiaochang era laws and orders have grown dim; those who kept faith and plain integrity found no way to be heard; long-held grievances had nowhere to plead.

sentences.zh: 其有事在通途，橫被疑異，名例無爽，枉見排抑，或選舉不平，或賦役煩苛，諸如此者不可具說。

translations.literal: Those whose affairs lie on the public road yet were wrongly suspected, whose cases under statute were without fault yet were wrongly suppressed, or who suffered unfair selection or onerous levies and corvée—such cases are too many to list.
translations.idiomatic: Those whose affairs belong on the public road yet were wrongly suspected, whose cases under statute were without fault yet were wrongly suppressed, or who suffered unfair selection or onerous levies and corvée—such cases are beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 其有訴人經公車注不合者，悉集華林東門，朕當親理冤獄，以申積滯。

translations.literal: Those whose petitions through the imperial coach office do not conform to procedure shall all assemble at the east gate of Hualin; We shall personally judge wrongful cases to clear accumulated wrongs.
translations.idiomatic: Those whose petitions through the imperial coach office do not conform to procedure shall all assemble at the east gate of Hualin; we shall personally judge wrongful cases to clear accumulated wrongs.

sentences.zh: 」己巳，齊州郡民賈皓聚眾反，夜襲州城，會明退走。

translations.literal: " day jisi: the people of Qi province, Jia Hao, gathered a host in rebellion, raided the provincial city by night, and at dawn withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: " On jisi day Jia Hao of Qi province gathered a host in rebellion, raided the provincial city by night, and withdrew at dawn.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，晉州刺史樊子鵠克唐州，斬刺史崔元珍、行臺酈惲，傳首京師。

translations.literal: day yihai: Regional Inspector of Jinzhou Fan Zihu took Tangzhou, beheaded Regional Inspector Cui Yuanzhen and Mobile-Circuit Attendant Li Yun, and sent their heads to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Fan Zihu, regional inspector of Jin, took Tangzhou, beheaded regional inspector Cui Yuanzhen and mobile-circuit attendant Li Yun, and sent their heads to the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔求德行、文藝、政事強直者，縣令、太守、刺史皆敍其志業，具以表聞。

translations.literal: day renwu: an edict sought men of virtue, literary accomplishment, and upright governance; magistrates, regional inspectors, and governors were all to set forth their aims and achievements in full memorial.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict sought men of virtue, literary accomplishment, and upright governance; magistrates, governors, and regional inspectors were to set forth aims and achievements in full memorial.

sentences.zh: 得三人以上，縣令、太守、刺史賞一階；

translations.literal: When three or more were obtained, the magistrate, governor, or regional inspector was rewarded one rank;
translations.idiomatic: When three or more worthy men were found, the magistrate, governor, or regional inspector was rewarded one rank;

sentences.zh: 舉非其人，亦黜一階。

translations.literal: if the men recommended were unfit, one rank was also demoted.
translations.idiomatic: if the men recommended were unfit, one rank was likewise demoted.

sentences.zh: 又以舊敍軍勳不過征虜，自今以後宜依前式以上，餘階積而為品。

translations.literal: It was also ordered that in the old system military merit ranks did not exceed General Who Campaigns Abroad; from now on they should follow the former pattern upward, with remaining ranks accumulating into grade.
translations.idiomatic: It was also ordered that under the old system military merit ranks did not exceed general who campaigns abroad; from now on they should follow the former pattern upward, with remaining ranks accumulating into grade.

sentences.zh: 其從輿駕北來之徒，不在此例。

translations.literal: Those who had followed the imperial carriage north were not in this category.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had followed the imperial carriage north were excepted.

sentences.zh: 悉不聽破品受階，破階請帛。

translations.literal: All were forbidden to break grade to receive rank; breaking rank was to request silk instead.
translations.idiomatic: All were forbidden to break grade to receive rank; breaking rank meant requesting silk instead.

sentences.zh: 先是，蕭衍遣其將曹義宗寇荊州。

translations.literal: Earlier Xiao Yan had sent his general Cao Yizong to raid Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Xiao Yan had sent his general Cao Yizong to raid Jing.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以中軍將軍、吏部尚書費穆為使持節、都督南征諸軍事，節度荊州刺史王羆以討之。

translations.literal: day guimao: General of the central army and Director of the Ministry of Personnel Fei Mu was made bearer of the staff of authority and commander of the southern campaign armies, directing Regional Inspector of Jing Wang Pi to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Fei Mu, general of the central army and director of the ministry of personnel, was made bearer of the staff and commander of the southern campaign armies, directing Wang Pi, regional inspector of Jing, to attack him.

sentences.zh: 六月丁亥朔，追封兄真定縣開國公子直為陳留王。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dinghai, new moon: the Emperor's elder brother, state-founding Duke of Zhending Zhi, was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Chenliu.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, the new moon of the sixth month, the emperor's elder brother Zhi, state-founding Duke of Zhending, was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Chenliu.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以鎮軍將軍、金紫光祿大夫李虔為車騎大將軍、儀同三司、特進。

translations.literal: day gengyin: General Who Guards the Army, Grand Master of Splendid Carriages Li Qian, was made Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Palace Attendant of the Third Rank, and specially advanced.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Li Qian, general who guards the army and grand master of splendid carriages, was made grand general of chariots and cavalry, palace attendant of the third rank, and specially advanced.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，南荊州刺史李志據城南叛。

translations.literal: day xinmao: Regional Inspector of Southern Jing Li Zhi held the south of the city in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Li Zhi, regional inspector of southern Jing, held the south of the city in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 通直散騎常侍高乾邕及弟等，率合流民、起兵於齊州之平原，頻破州軍，詔東道大使元欣喻旨，乃降。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant of Regular Attendance Gao Qianyou and his brothers led gathered refugees and raised troops on the plain of Qi province, repeatedly defeating provincial troops; the eastern-circuit envoy Yuan Xin conveyed the imperial intent, and they surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Qianyou, palace attendant of regular attendance, and his brothers led gathered refugees and raised troops on the plain of Qi, repeatedly defeating provincial troops; eastern-circuit envoy Yuan Xin conveyed the imperial intent, and they surrendered.

sentences.zh: 是月，葛榮飢，使其僕射任褒率車三萬餘乘南寇，至沁水。

translations.literal: That month Ge Rong, in famine, had his vice director Ren Bao lead more than thirty thousand carts south in raid, reaching Qin River.
translations.idiomatic: That month Ge Rong, starving, had his vice director Ren Bao lead more than thirty thousand carts south in raid as far as Qin River.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以高昌王世子光為平西將軍、瓜州刺史，襲爵泰臨縣開國伯、[2]高昌王。

translations.literal: day guimao: the heir of the King of Gaochang, Guang, was made General Who Pacifies the West and regional inspector of Guazhou, inheriting the title state-founding Marquis of Tailin, [2] King of Gaochang.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Guang, heir of the King of Gaochang, was made general who pacifies the west and regional inspector of Gua, inheriting the title state-founding Marquis of Tailin, [2] King of Gaochang.

sentences.zh: 太尉公、上黨王天穆為大都督、東北道諸軍事，率都督宗正珍孫、奚毅、賀拔勝、尒朱陽都等討任褒。

translations.literal: Minister of Works, Prince of Shangdang Tianmu, was made grand commander of the northeastern-route armies, leading Commandant of the Imperial Clan Zhensun, Xi Yi, Heba Sheng, Erzhu Yangdu, and others to attack Ren Bao.
translations.idiomatic: Tianmu, minister of works and Prince of Shangdang, was made grand commander of the northeastern-route armies, leading Zhensun, commandant of the imperial clan, Xi Yi, Heba Sheng, Erzhu Yangdu, and others against Ren Bao.

sentences.zh: 帝以寇難未夷，避正殿，責躬撤膳。

translations.literal: The Emperor, because bandit troubles were not yet settled, avoided the main hall, blamed himself, and withdrew delicacies.
translations.idiomatic: Because bandit troubles were not yet settled, the emperor avoided the main hall, blamed himself, and withdrew delicacies.

sentences.zh: 又班募格，收集忠勇。

translations.literal: Recruitment placards were also posted to gather the loyal and brave.
translations.idiomatic: Recruitment placards were also posted to gather the loyal and brave.

sentences.zh: 其有直言正諫之士、敢決徇義之夫、陳國家利害之謀、赴君親危難之節者，集華林園，面論事。

translations.literal: Those who offered straight counsel, men daring to die for righteousness, plans touching the state's gain and harm, or conduct answering peril to ruler and kin were to assemble at Hualin Park and discuss affairs face to face.
translations.idiomatic: Men of straight counsel, those ready to die for righteousness, advisers on the state's gain and harm, or anyone answering peril to ruler and kin were to gather at Hualin Park and speak with the throne face to face.

sentences.zh: 幽州平北府主簿河間邢杲，率河北流民十餘萬戶反於青州之北海，自署漢王，號年天統。

translations.literal: Xing Shuo, chief clerk of the Pingbei office in Youzhou, led more than a hundred thousand households of refugees from Hebei in rebellion at Beihai in Qingzhou, styled himself King of Han, and adopted the era name Tiantong.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Shuo, chief clerk of the Pingbei office in You, led more than a hundred thousand households of refugees from Hebei in rebellion at Beihai in Qing, styled himself King of Han, and adopted the era name Tiantong.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以征東將軍、金紫光祿大夫李叔仁為車騎大將軍、儀同三司，率眾討之。

translations.literal: day wushen: General Who Campaigns East, Grand Master of Splendid Carriages Li Shuren, was made Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Palace Attendant of the Third Rank, and led troops to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Li Shuren, general who campaigns east and grand master of splendid carriages, was made grand general of chariots and cavalry, palace attendant of the third rank, and led troops against him.

sentences.zh: 詔直寢紀業持節募新免牧戶，有投名効力者授九品官。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Direct Attendant Ji Ye, bearer of the staff, to recruit newly released pasture households; those who enrolled to serve were given ninth-rank office.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Ji Ye, direct attendant and bearer of the staff, to recruit newly released pasture households; those who enrolled to serve were given ninth-rank office.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔諸有私馬仗從戎者，職人優兩大階，亦授實官；

translations.literal: day jiyou: an edict said that those with private horses and arms who followed the campaign, if officeholders, received preferential advancement of two major ranks and also substantive office;
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day an edict said that those with private horses and arms who followed the campaign, if officeholders, received preferential advancement of two major ranks and also substantive office;

sentences.zh: 白民出身，外優兩階，亦授實官。

translations.literal: if commoners entering service, preferential advancement of two ranks outside the register and also substantive office.
translations.idiomatic: commoners entering service received two preferential ranks beyond the register and substantive office as well.

sentences.zh: 若武藝超倫者，雖無私馬，亦依前條；

translations.literal: If martial skill surpassed the norm, even without a private horse the previous article applied;
translations.idiomatic: If martial skill surpassed the norm, even without a private horse the same rule applied;

sentences.zh: 雖不超倫，但射槊翹關一藝而膽略有施者，依第出身外，特優一大階，授實官。

translations.literal: even if not surpassing the norm, but skilled in one art such as shooting the lance or lifting the bar and showing some mettle in courage and strategy, beyond rank by sequence one major rank was specially granted preferentially and substantive office given.
translations.idiomatic: if not surpassing the norm but skilled in one art—shooting the lance or lifting the bar—and showing courage and plan, beyond sequence one major rank was specially added and substantive office granted.

sentences.zh: 若無姓第者，從八品出身，階依前加，特授實官。

translations.literal: If there was no surname rank, entry was from the eighth rank, ranks added as before, and substantive office specially granted.
translations.idiomatic: Without a surname rank, entry began at the eighth rank, ranks were added as above, and substantive office was specially granted.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔曰：「朕當親御六戎，掃靜燕代，大將軍、太原王尒朱榮率精甲十萬為左軍，上黨王天穆總眾八萬為前軍，司徒公楊椿勒兵十萬為右軍，司空公穆紹統卒八萬為後軍。」

translations.literal: day xinhai: an edict said: "We shall personally lead the six armies, sweep and settle Yan and Dai; Grand General, Prince of Taiyuan Erzhu Rong shall lead a hundred thousand picked troops as the left army; Prince of Shangdang Tianmu shall command eighty thousand as the vanguard; Minister over the Masses Yang Chun shall marshal a hundred thousand as the right army; Minister of Works Mu Shao shall command eighty thousand as the rear army."
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day an edict said: "We shall personally lead the six armies and sweep Yan and Dai; Grand General Prince of Taiyuan Erzhu Rong shall lead a hundred thousand picked troops as the left army; Prince of Shangdang Tianmu eighty thousand as the vanguard; Minister over the Masses Yang Chun a hundred thousand as the right army; Minister of Works Mu Shao eighty thousand as the rear army."

sentences.zh: 是月，葛榮眾退屯相州之北。

translations.literal: That month Ge Rong's host withdrew and encamped north of Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month Ge Rong's host withdrew and encamped north of Xiang.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁巳，詔從四品以上從征者不得優階，正四品者優一階。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day dingsi: an edict said that from the fourth rank upward those who followed the campaign might not receive preferential rank; those of the regular fourth rank received one preferential rank.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day in the seventh month of autumn an edict said that from the fourth rank upward those who followed the campaign might not receive preferential rank; those of the regular fourth rank received one preferential rank.

sentences.zh: 軍級從三品以上從征，四品者優一大階。

translations.literal: In military grade from the third rank upward, if they followed the campaign, fourth-rank officials received one major preferential rank.
translations.idiomatic: By military grade, from the third rank up those who joined the campaign gave fourth-rank men one major preferential step.

sentences.zh: [3]正五品以下，還依前格，若有征階十餘，計入四品、三品。

translations.literal: [3] From the regular fifth rank downward, the former rules still applied; if campaign ranks totaled more than ten, they were counted into the fourth or third rank.
translations.idiomatic: [3] For the regular fifth rank and below the old rules still held; when campaign ranks exceeded ten in total, they were folded into the fourth or third rank.

sentences.zh: 限授五階。

translations.literal: Award was limited to five ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Award was limited to five ranks.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔前試守東郡太守唐景宣為持節、都督，於東郡召募僑居流民二千人，渡河隨便為柵，準望臺軍。

translations.literal: day jiwei: an edict made Tang Jingxuan, former provisional administrator of Dong Commandery, bearer of the staff and commander, to recruit two thousand sojourning refugees in Dong Commandery, cross the river and build stockades as convenient, and align with the imperial army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day an edict made Tang Jingxuan, former provisional administrator of Dong, bearer of the staff and commander, to recruit two thousand sojourning refugees in Dong Commandery, cross the river and build stockades as convenient, and align with the imperial army.

sentences.zh: 是月，齊獻武王於鄴西北慰喻葛榮別帥稱王者七人，眾萬餘，降之。

translations.literal: That month Qi Xianwu Wang northwest of Ye comforted and instructed seven of Ge Rong's detached chiefs who styled themselves kings, more than ten thousand in all, and they surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: That month Qi Xianwu Wang northwest of Ye comforted and instructed seven of Ge Rong's detached chiefs who styled themselves kings—more than ten thousand in all—and they surrendered.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，加大將軍尒朱榮柱國大將軍、錄尚書事。

translations.literal: day yichou: Grand General Erzhu Rong was given the additional titles of Pillar Grand General and recorder of Secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Grand General Erzhu Rong was given the additional titles of pillar grand general and recorder of secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，尚書奏斷百官公給衣冠、劍佩、綬舄。

translations.literal: day xinsi: the Secretariat memorialized cutting off the public provision of robes, caps, swords, girdles, and shoes for the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day the secretariat memorialized cutting off the public provision of robes, caps, swords, girdles, and shoes for the hundred officials.

sentences.zh: 壬子，光州人劉舉聚眾數千反於濮陽，自稱皇武大將軍。

translations.literal: day renzi: Liu Ju of Guang province gathered several thousand in rebellion at Puyang and styled himself Grand General Huangwu.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Liu Ju of Guang province gathered several thousand in rebellion at Puyang and styled himself Grand General Huangwu.

sentences.zh: 是月，高平鎮人万俟醜奴僭稱大位，署置百官。

translations.literal: That month a man of Gaoping garrison, Moqi Chounu, usurped the great position and installed the hundred offices.
translations.idiomatic: That month Moqi Chounu of Gaoping garrison usurped the great position and installed the hundred offices.

sentences.zh: 是月，[4]臨淮王彧自江南還朝。

translations.literal: That month, [4] Prince of Huaiyin Yu returned to court from the south.
translations.idiomatic: That month [4] Prince of Huaiyin Yu came back to court from the south.

sentences.zh: 八月，太山太守羊侃據郡引蕭衍將軍王辯攻兗州。

translations.literal: Eighth month: Yang Kan, administrator of Taishan, held the commandery and brought in Xiao Yan's general Wang Bian to attack Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Yang Kan, administrator of Tai, held the commandery and brought in Xiao Yan's general Wang Bian to attack Yan.

sentences.zh: [5]甲辰，詔大都督宗正珍孫率南廣州刺史、都督鄭先護討劉舉於濮陽，破平之。

translations.literal: [5] day jiachen: an edict ordered Grand Commander Zhensun, commandant of the imperial clan, to lead Regional Inspector of Southern Guang Zheng Xianhu to attack Liu Ju at Puyang; he was defeated and pacified.
translations.idiomatic: [5] On jiachen day an edict ordered Grand Commander Zhensun, commandant of the imperial clan, to lead Zheng Xianhu, regional inspector of southern Guang, to attack Liu Ju at Puyang; he was defeated and pacified.

sentences.zh: 以侍中、驃騎大將軍、臨淮王彧為儀同三司。

translations.literal: Attendant-in-ordinary, Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Prince of Huaiyin Yu, was made Palace Attendant of the Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Yu, attendant-in-ordinary, grand general of agile cavalry, and Prince of Huaiyin, was made palace attendant of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 是月，車騎大將軍、儀同三司李叔仁討邢杲於濰水，失利而還。

translations.literal: That month Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Palace Attendant of the Third Rank Li Shuren attacked Xing Shuo on the Wei River, was defeated, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: That month Li Shuren, grand general of chariots and cavalry and palace attendant of the third rank, attacked Xing Shuo on the Wei River, was defeated, and returned.

sentences.zh: 大都督費穆大破蕭衍軍，擒其將曹義宗，檻送京師。

translations.literal: Grand Commander Fei Mu greatly defeated Xiao Yan's army, captured his general Cao Yizong, and sent him caged to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Commander Fei Mu routed Xiao Yan's forces, took his general Cao Yizong, and sent him to the capital in a cage.

sentences.zh: 蕭衍以北海王顥為魏主，號年孝基，入據南兗之銍城。

translations.literal: Xiao Yan made Prince of Beihai Hao ruler of Wei, era name Xiaoji, and he entered and held Qiaocheng in southern Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yan made Prince of Beihai Hao ruler of Wei, era name Xiaoji; he entered and held Qiaocheng in southern Yan.

sentences.zh: 十有一月戊午，以無上王世子韶為彭城王，陳留王子寬為陳留王，寬弟剛為浮陽王，剛弟質為林慮王。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuwu: the heir of Prince Without Superior Shao was made Prince of Pengcheng; Zikuan, son of Prince of Chenliu, was made Prince of Chenliu; his younger brother Gang was made Prince of Fuyang; Gang's younger brother Zhi was made Prince of Linlu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day in the eleventh month the heir of Prince Without Superior Shao was made Prince of Pengcheng; Zikuan, son of Prince of Chenliu, Prince of Chenliu; his younger brother Gang, Prince of Fuyang; Gang's younger brother Zhi, Prince of Linlu.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，齊獻武王、行臺于暉，與徐兗行臺崔孝芬、大都督刁宣大破羊侃於瑕丘，侃奔蕭衍。

translations.literal: day guihai: Qi Xianwu Wang and Mobile-Circuit Attendant Yu Hui, with the Xu-Yan mobile circuit Yu Xiaofen and Grand Commander Diao Xuan, greatly defeated Yang Kan at Xiaqiu; Kan fled to Xiao Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Qi Xianwu Wang and mobile-circuit attendant Yu Hui, with the Xu-Yan mobile circuit Yu Xiaofen and Grand Commander Diao Xuan, greatly defeated Yang Kan at Xiaqiu; Kan fled to Xiao Yan.

sentences.zh: 兗州平。

translations.literal: Yanzhou was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Yan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以上黨王天穆為大將軍、開府，世襲并州刺史。

translations.literal: day wuyin: Prince of Shangdang Tianmu was made grand general and commissioner with credentials, with hereditary regional inspector of Bing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Prince of Shangdang Tianmu was made grand general and commissioner with credentials, with hereditary regional inspector of Bing.

sentences.zh: 封前將軍、太中大夫元凝為東安王。

translations.literal: Former General, Grand Master of the Palace Yuan Ning was enfeoffed as Prince of Dong'an.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Ning, former general and grand master of the palace, was enfeoffed Prince of Dong'an.

sentences.zh: 十有二月庚子，詔行臺于暉回師討邢杲，次於歷下。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengzi: an edict ordered Mobile-Circuit Attendant Yu Hui to return his army and attack Xing Shuo, halting at Lixia.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengzi day, an edict ordered Yu Hui, mobile-circuit attendant, to return his army and attack Xing Shuo, halting at Lixia.

sentences.zh: 是歲，葛榮餘黨韓樓復據幽州反。

translations.literal: That year the remnant band of Ge Rong, Han Lou, again held Youzhou in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: That year Han Lou, a remnant of Ge Rong's band, again held You in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月甲寅，于暉所部都督彭樂率二千餘騎北走於韓樓，乃班師。

translations.literal: First month of spring of the second year, day jiayin: Yu Hui's commander Peng Le led more than two thousand cavalry north to Han Lou, and the army then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the second year, on jiayin day, Peng Le, commander under Yu Hui, led more than two thousand cavalry north to Han Lou, and the army then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 二月癸未朔，詔諸禁衞之官從戎有功及傷夷者，赴選先敍。

translations.literal: Second month, day guimao, new moon: an edict said that palace guard officials who had merit in the campaign or wounds were to be advanced first at selection.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the new moon of the second month, an edict said that palace guard officials who had merit in the campaign or wounds were to be advanced first at selection.

sentences.zh: 甲午，尊皇考為文穆皇帝，廟號肅祖，皇妣為文穆皇后。

translations.literal: day jiawu: the late Emperor, the Emperor's father, was honored as Emperor Wenmu, temple name Suzu; the late Empress, the Emperor's mother, as Empress Wenmu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the late emperor, the emperor's father, was honored as Emperor Wenmu, temple name Suzu; the late empress, the emperor's mother, as Empress Wenmu.

sentences.zh: 燕州民王慶祖聚眾於上黨，自稱為王。

translations.literal: The people of Yan province, Wang Qingzu, gathered a host at Shangdang and styled himself king.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Qingzu of Yan province gathered a host at Shangdang and styled himself king.

sentences.zh: 柱國大將軍尒朱榮討擒之。

translations.literal: Pillar Grand General Erzhu Rong attacked, captured him.
translations.idiomatic: Pillar Grand General Erzhu Rong attacked and captured him.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔散騎常侍濟陰王暉業兼行臺尚書，督都督李德龍、丘大千鎮梁國。

translations.literal: day renyin: an edict made Palace Attendant of Regular Attendance Prince of Jiyin Huiye concurrently act as mobile-circuit director of the secretariat, supervising Commanders Li Delong and Qiu Daqian in guarding Liang province.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day an edict made Huiye, palace attendant of regular attendance and Prince of Jiyin, concurrently act as mobile-circuit director of the secretariat, supervising Li Delong and Qiu Daqian in guarding Liang.

sentences.zh: 三月壬戌，詔大將軍、上黨王天穆與齊獻武王討邢杲。

translations.literal: Third month, day renxu: an edict ordered Grand General, Prince of Shangdang Tianmu, and Qi Xianwu Wang to attack Xing Shuo.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day in the third month an edict ordered Tianmu, grand general and Prince of Shangdang, and Qi Xianwu Wang to attack Xing Shuo.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸未，遷肅祖文穆皇帝及文穆皇后神主于太廟，內外百僚普汎加一級。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, day guimao: the spirit tablets of Suzu Emperor Wenmu and Empress Wenmu were moved to the Grand Temple; officials within and without all received a general promotion of one rank.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day in the fourth month of summer the spirit tablets of Suzu Emperor Wenmu and Empress Wenmu were moved to the Grand Temple; officials within and without all received a general promotion of one rank.

sentences.zh: 曲赦畿內，死罪至流人減一等，徒刑以下悉免。

translations.literal: A partial amnesty within the capital region: death through exile was reduced one degree; penal servitude and below were all remitted.
translations.idiomatic: A partial amnesty in the capital region cut death and exile sentences by one degree and freed all penal servitude and below.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔太原王尒朱榮下將士並汎加二級。

translations.literal: day gengzi: an edict ordered a general promotion of two ranks for officers and soldiers under Prince of Taiyuan Erzhu Rong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day an edict ordered a general promotion of two ranks for officers and soldiers under Prince of Taiyuan Erzhu Rong.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，上黨王天穆、齊獻武王大破邢杲於齊州之濟南，杲降，送京師，斬於都市。

translations.literal: day xinchou: Prince of Shangdang Tianmu and Qi Xianwu Wang greatly defeated Xing Shuo at Jinan in Qi province; Shuo surrendered, was sent to the capital, and beheaded in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Prince of Shangdang Tianmu and Qi Xianwu Wang greatly defeated Xing Shuo at Jinan in Qi; Shuo surrendered, was sent to the capital, and beheaded in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 元顥攻陷考城，執行臺元暉業、都督丘大千。

translations.literal: Yuan Hao took and held Kaocheng, capturing Mobile-Circuit Attendant Yuan Huiye and Commander Qiu Daqian.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Hao took Kaocheng, capturing Yuan Huiye, mobile-circuit attendant, and Commander Qiu Daqian.

sentences.zh: 五月壬子朔，元顥克梁國。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renzi, new moon: Yuan Hao took Liang province.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, the new moon of the fifth month, Yuan Hao took Liang province.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以撫軍將軍、前徐州刺史楊昱為使持節、鎮東將軍、東南道大都督，率眾鎮滎陽；

translations.literal: day dingsi: General Who Guards the Army, former Regional Inspector of Xuzhou Yang Yu, was made bearer of the staff of authority, General Who Pacifies the East, and grand commander of the southeastern route, leading troops to guard Xingyang;
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Yang Yu, general who guards the army and former regional inspector of Xu, was made bearer of the staff, general who pacifies the east, and grand commander of the southeastern route, leading troops to guard Xingyang;

sentences.zh: 尚書僕射尒朱世隆鎮虎牢；

translations.literal: Right Vice Director of the Secretariat Erzhu Shilong guarded Hulao;
translations.idiomatic: Erzhu Shilong, right vice director of the secretariat, guarded Hulao;

sentences.zh: 侍中尒朱世承鎮崿岅。

translations.literal: Attendant-in-ordinary Erzhu Shicheng guarded Mount Yao.
translations.idiomatic: Erzhu Shicheng, attendant-in-ordinary, guarded Mount Yao.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔私馬仗從戎優階授官。

translations.literal: day xinyou: an edict on preferential rank and office for those with private horses and arms who followed the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day an edict on preferential rank and office for those with private horses and arms who followed the campaign.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，又詔募士一依征葛榮。

translations.literal: day renxu: another edict recruited soldiers according to the campaign against Ge Rong.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day another edict recruited soldiers according to the campaign against Ge Rong.

sentences.zh: 甲子，又詔職人及民出馬，優階各有差。

translations.literal: day jiazi: another edict said that officeholders and commoners who furnished horses received preferential ranks in differing degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day another edict said that officeholders and commoners who furnished horses received preferential ranks in differing degrees.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，內外戒嚴。

translations.literal: day yichou: martial law within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day martial law was proclaimed within and without.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，元顥陷滎陽，執楊昱。

translations.literal: day guiyou: Yuan Hao took Xingyang and captured Yang Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Yuan Hao took Xingyang and captured Yang Yu.

sentences.zh: 尒朱世隆棄虎牢遁還。

translations.literal: Erzhu Shilong abandoned Hulao and fled back.
translations.idiomatic: Erzhu Shilong abandoned Hulao and fled back.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，車駕北巡，乙亥，幸河內。

translations.literal: day jiaxu: the imperial carriage toured north; day yihai: it reached Henei.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the imperial carriage toured north; on yihai day it reached Henei.

sentences.zh: 丙子，元顥入洛。

translations.literal: day bingzi: Yuan Hao entered Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Yuan Hao entered Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，進封城陽縣開國公元祉為平原王，安昌縣開國侯元鷙為華山王，並加儀同三司。

translations.literal: day dingchou: state-founding Duke of Chengyang Zhi was advanced to Prince of Pingyuan; state-founding Marquis of Anchang Chi was made Prince of Huashan; both were given Palace Attendant of the Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Zhi, state-founding Duke of Chengyang, was advanced to Prince of Pingyuan; Chi, state-founding Marquis of Anchang, was made Prince of Huashan; both were given palace attendant of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，行臺崔孝芬、大都督刁宣破元顥後軍都督侯暄於梁國，斬之，擒其卒三千人。

translations.literal: day wuyin: Mobile-Circuit Attendant Cui Xiaofen and Grand Commander Diao Xuan defeated Yuan Hao's rear-army commander Hou Xuan at Liang province, beheaded him, and captured three thousand of his troops.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Cui Xiaofen, mobile-circuit attendant, and Grand Commander Diao Xuan defeated Yuan Hao's rear-army commander Hou Xuan at Liang, beheaded him, and captured three thousand troops.

sentences.zh: 以侍中、車騎將軍、尚書右僕射尒朱世隆為使持節、行臺僕射、本將軍、相州刺史，鎮鄴城，以便宜從事。

translations.literal: Attendant-in-ordinary, Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Right Vice Director of the Secretariat Erzhu Shilong, was made bearer of the staff of authority, mobile-circuit vice director of the secretariat, general of his former post, and regional inspector of Xiang, guarding Ye city with discretionary authority.
translations.idiomatic: Erzhu Shilong, attendant-in-ordinary, grand general of chariots and cavalry, and right vice director of the secretariat, was made bearer of the staff, mobile-circuit vice director of the secretariat, general of his former post, and regional inspector of Xiang, guarding Ye with discretionary authority.

sentences.zh: 又詔上黨百年以下九十以上板三品郡，八十以上四品郡，七十以上五品郡。

translations.literal: Another edict said that in Shangdang those below a hundred and above ninety received third-rank commandery plaque; above eighty, fourth-rank commandery; above seventy, fifth-rank commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict in Shangdang conferred third-rank commandery plaque on those under a hundred and ninety or more; fourth-rank at eighty; fifth-rank at seventy.

sentences.zh: 太原王尒朱榮會車駕於長子，即日反斾。

translations.literal: Prince of Taiyuan Erzhu Rong met the imperial carriage at Changzi and the same day turned his banners back.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Taiyuan Erzhu Rong met the emperor at Changzi and turned his banners back the same day.

sentences.zh: 上黨王天穆北渡，會車駕於河內。

translations.literal: Prince of Shangdang Tianmu crossed north and met the imperial carriage at Henei.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Shangdang Tianmu crossed north and met the imperial carriage at Henei.

sentences.zh: 六月己丑，儀同三司費穆為顥所害。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jichou: Palace Attendant of the Third Rank Fei Mu was killed by Hao.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day in the sixth month Fei Mu, palace attendant of the third rank, was killed by Hao.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，克河內，斬太守元襲、都督宗正珍孫。

translations.literal: day renyin: Henei was taken; Administrator Yuan Xi and Commander Zhensun were beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Henei was taken; Administrator Yuan Xi and Commander Zhensun were beheaded.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊辰，都督尒朱兆、賀拔勝從硤石夜濟，破顥子冠受及安豐王延明軍，元顥敗走。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day wuchen: Commanders Erzhu Zhao and Heba Sheng crossed from Shixia by night, defeated Hao's son Guanshou and Prince of Anfeng Yanming's army; Yuan Hao was defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day in the seventh month of autumn Commanders Erzhu Zhao and Heba Sheng crossed from Shixia by night, defeated Hao's son Guanshou and Prince of Anfeng Yanming's army; Yuan Hao was defeated and fled.

sentences.zh: 庚午，車駕入居華林園，昇大夏門，大赦天下。

translations.literal: day gengwu: the imperial carriage entered and dwelt at Hualin Park, ascended the Great Summer Gate, and proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the imperial carriage entered Hualin Park, ascended the Great Summer Gate, and proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 以使持節、車騎將軍、都督、潁川郡開國公尒朱兆為車騎大將軍、儀同三司。

translations.literal: Bearer of the staff of authority, Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Commander, state-founding Duke of Yingchuan Erzhu Zhao, was made Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Palace Attendant of the Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Erzhu Zhao, bearer of the staff, grand general of chariots and cavalry, commander, and state-founding Duke of Yingchuan, was made grand general of chariots and cavalry and palace attendant of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 詔以前朝勳書多竊冒，宜一切焚棄之，若立效灼然為時所知者，別加科賞。

translations.literal: An edict said that merit registers of the former court were much falsely claimed; they should all be burned; if achievement was clearly established and known to the age, separate rewards in kind would be given.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said that merit registers of the former court were much falsely claimed and should all be burned; if achievement was clearly established and known to the age, separate rewards in kind would be given.

sentences.zh: 蕃客及邊酋翻城降，有勳未叙者，不在焚斷之限。

translations.literal: Foreign guests and frontier chiefs who turned cities and surrendered, with merit not yet recorded, were not within the limit of burning.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign guests and frontier chiefs who turned in cities and surrendered, with merit still unrecorded, were excepted from the burning.

sentences.zh: 北來軍士及隨駕文武、馬渚立義，[7]加汎五級；

translations.literal: Northern soldiers and civil and military officials who followed the carriage, and those who established righteousness at Mazhu, [7] received a general promotion of five ranks;
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers from the north and civil and military officials who followed the carriage, and those who took up righteousness at Mazhu, [7] all received a general promotion of five ranks;

sentences.zh: 河北執事之官，二級；

translations.literal: executive officials of Hebei, two ranks;
translations.idiomatic: executive officials in Hebei, two ranks;

sentences.zh: 河南立義及迎駕之官，并中途扈從，亦二級。

translations.literal: those of Henan who established righteousness and officials who welcomed the carriage, and also those who escorted midway, likewise two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: those in Henan who took up righteousness, officials who welcomed the carriage, and escorts along the route likewise received two ranks.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以柱國大將軍、太原王尒朱榮為天柱大將軍，加前後部羽葆、鼓吹。

translations.literal: day renshen: Pillar Grand General, Prince of Taiyuan Erzhu Rong, was made Pillar of Heaven Grand General, with front and rear feathered canopy and martial pipes added.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Pillar Grand General Prince of Taiyuan Erzhu Rong was made Pillar of Heaven Grand General, with front and rear feathered canopy and martial pipes added.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，臨潁縣卒江豐斬元顥，傳首京師。

translations.literal: day guiyou: Jiang Feng, a soldier of Linying county, beheaded Yuan Hao and sent his head to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Jiang Feng, a soldier of Linying county, beheaded Yuan Hao and sent his head to the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以大將軍、上黨王天穆為太宰，司徒公、城陽王徽為大司馬、太尉公。

translations.literal: day jiaxu: Grand General, Prince of Shangdang Tianmu, was made Grand Preceptor; Minister over the Masses, Prince of Chengyang Hui, was made Grand Marshal and Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Tianmu, grand general and Prince of Shangdang, was made grand preceptor; Hui, minister over the masses and Prince of Chengyang, was made grand marshal and minister of works.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，宴勞天柱大將軍尒朱榮、上黨王天穆及北來督將於都亭，出宮人三百、繒錦雜綵數萬匹，班賜有差。

translations.literal: day yihai: at the Capital Pavilion a feast rewarded Pillar of Heaven Grand General Erzhu Rong, Prince of Shangdang Tianmu, and the northern commanders; three hundred palace women and tens of thousands of bolts of silk and brocade of mixed colors were distributed with differing allotments.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day at the Capital Pavilion a feast rewarded Pillar of Heaven Grand General Erzhu Rong, Prince of Shangdang Tianmu, and the northern commanders; three hundred palace women and tens of thousands of bolts of silk and brocade were distributed with differing allotments.

sentences.zh: 又諸州郡遣使奉表行宮者，並加一大階。

translations.literal: Also, envoys from provinces and commanderies who presented memorials at the traveling palace all received one major rank.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys from provinces and commanderies who presented memorials at the traveling palace also each gained one major rank.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，獲元顥弟頊，[8]斬於都市。

translations.literal: day dingchou: Yuan Hao's younger brother Xu was captured, [8] and beheaded in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Yuan Hao's younger brother Xu was captured, [8] and beheaded in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 詔受元顥爵賞、階級，悉追奪之。

translations.literal: An edict stripped all titles, rewards, and ranks given to those who had served Yuan Hao.
translations.idiomatic: An edict rescinded every title, reward, and rank granted to those who had followed Yuan Hao.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以鎮東將軍、南青州刺史元旭為襄城王，平南將軍、南兗州刺史元暹為汝陽王。

translations.literal: day jimao: General Who Pacifies the East, Regional Inspector of Southern Qing Yuan Xu, was made Prince of Xiangcheng; General Who Pacifies the South, Regional Inspector of Southern Yan Yuan Xian, was made Prince of Ruyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Xu, general who pacifies the east and regional inspector of southern Qing, was made Prince of Xiangcheng; Xian, general who pacifies the south and regional inspector of southern Yan, was made Prince of Ruyang.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛巳，帝始居宮內。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day xinsi: the Emperor first dwelt within the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day in the intercalary month the emperor first dwelt within the palace.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以車騎將軍、兼吏部尚書楊津為司空。

translations.literal: day xinmao: Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, concurrently Director of the Ministry of Personnel Yang Jin, was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Yang Jin, grand general of chariots and cavalry and concurrently director of the ministry of personnel, was made minister of works.

sentences.zh: 巴州刺史嚴始欣據州南叛，蕭衍遣其將蕭玩、張鴻、江茂達等率眾赴援。

translations.literal: Yan Shixin, regional inspector of Ba, held the south of the province in rebellion; Xiao Yan sent his generals Xiao Wan, Zhang Hong, Jiang Maoda, and others with troops to aid him.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Shixin, regional inspector of Ba, rebelled and held the south of the province; Xiao Yan sent generals Xiao Wan, Zhang Hong, Jiang Maoda, and others to relieve him.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌朔，詔諸有公私債負，一錢以上巨萬以還，悉皆禁斷，不得徵責。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengxu, new moon: an edict forbade collection of public and private debts from one cash up to ten thousand in return—all collection was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, the new moon of the eighth month, an edict forbade collection of public and private debts from one cash up to ten thousand in return—all collection was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 己未，以侍中、太傅李延寔為司徒公。

translations.literal: day jiwei: Attendant-in-ordinary, Grand Tutor Li Yanshi, was made Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Li Yanshi, attendant-in-ordinary and grand tutor, was made minister over the masses.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，封瓜州刺史元太榮為東陽王。

translations.literal: day dingmao: Regional Inspector of Guazhou Yuan Tairong was enfeoffed as Prince of Dongyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Yuan Tairong, regional inspector of Gua, was enfeoffed Prince of Dongyang.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，侍中、太保楊椿致仕。

translations.literal: day jiaxu: Attendant-in-ordinary, Grand Guardian Yang Chun, resigned office.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Yang Chun, attendant-in-ordinary and grand guardian, resigned office.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔車騎將軍、右光祿大夫奚毅板授天柱大將軍尒朱榮、太宰天穆下勳及祖父叔伯耆年者牧守有差。

translations.literal: day yihai: an edict ordered Grand Master of the Right Splendid Carriages Xi Yi to confer by plaque ranks on officers under Pillar of Heaven Grand General Erzhu Rong and Grand Preceptor Tianmu and on elders among fathers, uncles, and brothers, with differing governorships.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day an edict ordered Xi Yi, grand master of the right splendid carriages, to confer by plaque ranks on officers under Pillar of Heaven Grand General Erzhu Rong and Grand Preceptor Tianmu and on elders among fathers, uncles, and brothers, with differing governorships.

sentences.zh: 九月，大都督侯淵討韓樓於薊，破斬之。

translations.literal: Ninth month: Grand Commander Hou Yuan attacked Han Lou at Ji, defeated and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Grand Commander Hou Yuan attacked Han Lou at Ji, defeated and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 幽州平。

translations.literal: Youzhou was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: You was pacified.

sentences.zh: 万俟醜奴攻東秦城，陷之，殺刺史高子朗。

translations.literal: Moqi Chounu attacked the city of Eastern Qin, took it, and killed Regional Inspector Gao Zilang.
translations.idiomatic: Moqi Chounu attacked the city of Eastern Qin, took it, and killed Gao Zilang, regional inspector.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁丑，以前司空公、丹陽王蕭贊為司徒公。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day dingchou: former Minister of Works, Prince of Danyang Xiao Zan, was made Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day in the tenth month of winter Xiao Zan, former minister of works and Prince of Danyang, was made minister over the masses.

sentences.zh: 十有一月己卯，就德興自營州遣使請降。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jimao: Jiudexing of Yingzhou sent envoys asking to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day in the eleventh month Jiudexing of Ying sent envoys asking to surrender.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔羣官休停在外者皆令赴闕，程會有差。

translations.literal: day dinghai: an edict ordered all officials on leave or stationed outside to come to court, with differing deadlines.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day an edict ordered all officials on leave or stationed outside to come to court, with differing deadlines.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以大司馬、太尉公、城陽王徽為太保，司徒公、丹陽王蕭贊為太尉公，開府儀同三司、雍州刺史長孫稚為司徒公。

translations.literal: day bingwu: Grand Marshal, Minister of Works, Prince of Chengyang Hui, was made Grand Guardian; Minister over the Masses, Prince of Danyang Xiao Zan, was made Minister of Works; Commissioner with Credentials of the Third Rank, Regional Inspector of Yong Changsun Zhi, was made Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Hui, grand marshal, minister of works, and Prince of Chengyang, was made grand guardian; Xiao Zan, minister over the masses and Prince of Danyang, minister of works; Changsun Zhi, commissioner with credentials of the third rank and regional inspector of Yong, minister over the masses.

sentences.zh: 十有二月辛亥，蕭衍兗州刺史張景邕、荊州刺史李靈起、雄信將軍蕭進明來降。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinhai: Zhang Jingyou, regional inspector of Yan under Xiao Yan; Li Lingqi, regional inspector of Jing; and Xiong Xin General Xiao Jinming came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day in the twelfth month Zhang Jingyou, Xiao Yan's regional inspector of Yan; Li Lingqi of Jing; and Xiong Xin General Xiao Jinming came to surrender.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月己丑，益州刺史長孫壽、梁州刺史元儁等，遣將與征巴州都督元景夏討嚴始欣，斬之。

translations.literal: First month of spring of the third year, day jichou: Regional Inspector of Yi Changshou Shou and Regional Inspector of Liang Yuan Jun and others sent generals with Commander Yuan Jingxia, who campaigns at Ba, to attack Yan Shixin and behead him.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day in the first month of spring of the third year Changshou Shou, regional inspector of Yi, and Yuan Jun, regional inspector of Liang, and others sent generals with Yuan Jingxia, commander who campaigns at Ba, to attack Yan Shixin and behead him.

sentences.zh: 蕭衍都督蕭玩、何難尉、陳愁敗走，斬玩首，俘獲萬餘人。

translations.literal: Xiao Yan's commanders Xiao Wan, He Nanwei, and Chen Chou were defeated and fled; Wan's head was cut off and more than ten thousand were captured.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yan's commanders Xiao Wan, He Nanwei, and Chen Chou were routed; Wan was beheaded and more than ten thousand taken.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，東徐州城民呂文欣、王赦等殺刺史元太賓，據城反。

translations.literal: day xinchou: the people of Dongxu city, Lü Wenxin and Wang She and others, killed Regional Inspector Yuan Taibin and held the city in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day the people of Dongxu city, Lü Wenxin and Wang She and others, killed Yuan Taibin, regional inspector, and held the city in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 以撫軍將軍、都官尚書樊子鵠兼右僕射，為行臺，督征南將軍、都督賈顯智，征東將軍、徐州刺史嚴思達以討之。

translations.literal: General Who Guards the Army, Director of the Ministry of Punishments Fan Zihu, was made concurrently Right Vice Director and mobile-circuit attendant, supervising General Who Campaigns South, Commander Jia Xianzhi, and General Who Campaigns East, Regional Inspector of Xuzhou Yan Sida, to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zihu, general who guards the army and director of the ministry of punishments, was made concurrently right vice director and mobile-circuit attendant, supervising Jia Xianzhi, general who campaigns south and commander, and Yan Sida, general who campaigns east and regional inspector of Xu, to attack them.

sentences.zh: 二月甲寅，克之。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiayin: it was taken.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day in the second month it was taken.

sentences.zh: 東徐平。

translations.literal: Eastern Xu was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Xu was pacified.

sentences.zh: 三月，醜奴大行臺尉遲菩薩寇岐州，大都督賀拔岳、可朱渾道元大破之。

translations.literal: Third month: Chounu's grand mobile-circuit Yuchi Pusa raided Qi province; Grand Commander Heba Yue and Kezhun Hun Daoyuan greatly defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Yuchi Pusa, Chounu's grand mobile-circuit attendant, raided Qi; Grand Commander Heba Yue and Kezhun Hun Daoyuan greatly defeated him.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁巳，以侍中、太尉公、丹陽王蕭贊為使持節、都督齊濟兗三州諸軍事、驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、齊州刺史。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, day dingsi: Minister of Works, Prince of Danyang Xiao Zan, was made bearer of the staff of authority, commander of the armies of Qi, Ji, and Yan provinces, Grand General of Agile Cavalry, commissioner with credentials of the third rank, and regional inspector of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day in the fourth month of summer Xiao Zan, minister of works and Prince of Danyang, was made bearer of the staff, commander of the armies of Qi, Ji, and Yan, grand general of agile cavalry with credentials of the third rank, and regional inspector of Qi.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，雍州刺史尒朱天光討醜奴、蕭寶夤於安定，破擒之，囚送京師。

translations.literal: day dingmao: Regional Inspector of Yong Erzhu Tianguang attacked Chounu and Xiao Baoyin at Anding, defeated and captured them, and sent them imprisoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Erzhu Tianguang, regional inspector of Yong, attacked Chounu and Xiao Baoyin at Anding, defeated and captured them, and sent them imprisoned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以關中平，大赦天下。

translations.literal: day jiaxu: because Guanzhong was pacified, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, because Guanzhong was pacified, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 醜奴斬於都市，寶夤賜死於駝牛署。

translations.literal: Chounu was beheaded in the marketplace; Baoyin was granted death at the Camel-Ox Office.
translations.idiomatic: Chounu was executed in the marketplace; Baoyin was granted death at the Camel-Ox Office.

sentences.zh: 六月戊午，詔胡氏親屬受爵於朝者黜附編民。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuwu: an edict said that kin of the Hu clan who had received titles at court were demoted and attached to the registered populace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day in the sixth month an edict said that kin of the Hu clan who had received titles at court were demoted and attached to the registered populace.

sentences.zh: [9]嚈達國獻師子一。

translations.literal: [9] The state of Yanda presented one lion.
translations.idiomatic: [9] The state of Yanda presented one lion.

sentences.zh: 是月，白馬龍涸胡王慶雲僭稱大位於水洛城，[10]署置百官。

translations.literal: That month Hu Wang Qingyun of the dried-up White Horse Dragon Pool usurped the great position at Shuiluo city, [10] and installed the hundred offices.
translations.idiomatic: That month Qingyun, king of the Hu at the dried-up White Horse Dragon Pool, usurped the great position at Shuiluo city, [10] and installed the hundred offices.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙子，天光平水洛城，擒慶雲，坑其城民一萬七千。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day bingzi: Tianguang pacified Shuiluo city, captured Qingyun, and buried alive seventeen thousand of its people.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day in the seventh month of autumn Tianguang pacified Shuiluo city, captured Qingyun, and buried alive seventeen thousand of its people.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，蕭衍民革虬、卜湯世率堡聚內附。

translations.literal: day guisi: the people Ge Qiu and Bu Tangshi of Xiao Yan led fortified hamlets in submission.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Ge Qiu and Bu Tangshi, people of Xiao Yan, led fortified hamlets in submission.

sentences.zh: 庚子，車騎大將軍、儀同三司李叔仁坐事除名為民。

translations.literal: day gengzi: Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Palace Attendant of the Third Rank Li Shuren, for an offense was stripped of name and made a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Li Shuren, grand general of chariots and cavalry and palace attendant of the third rank, for an offense was stripped of name and made a commoner.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，天柱大將軍尒朱榮、上黨王天穆自晉陽來朝。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinmao: Pillar of Heaven Grand General Erzhu Rong and Prince of Shangdang Tianmu came to court from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day in the ninth month Pillar of Heaven Grand General Erzhu Rong and Prince of Shangdang Tianmu came to court from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，帝殺榮、天穆於明光殿，及榮子儀同三司菩提。

translations.literal: day wuxu: the Emperor killed Rong and Tianmu in the Mingguang Hall, and Rong's son Bodhi, Palace Attendant of the Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the emperor killed Rong and Tianmu in the Mingguang Hall, and Rong's son Bodhi, palace attendant of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 乃昇閶闔門，詔曰：

translations.literal: Then the Chongxu Gate was raised; an edict said:
translations.idiomatic: Then the Chongxu Gate was raised; an edict said:

sentences.zh: 蓋天道忌盈，人倫嫉惡，疏而不漏，刑之無捨。

translations.literal: Heaven's Way abhors excess; human norms detest evil; what is loose is not left out, and punishment knows no sparing.
translations.idiomatic: The Way of Heaven hates fullness; human custom hates wickedness—nothing loose escapes, and punishment does not spare.

sentences.zh: 是以呂霍之門，禍譴所伏；

translations.literal: Thus at the gates of Lü and Huo calamity was the place of retribution;
translations.idiomatic: So at the gates of Lü and Huo retribution found its seat;

sentences.zh: 梁董之家，咎徵斯在。

translations.literal: in the houses of Liang and Dong the omen of guilt stood forth.
translations.idiomatic: in the houses of Liang and Dong the sign of guilt appeared.

sentences.zh: 頃孝昌之末，天步孔艱，女主亂政，監國無主。

translations.literal: Lately at the end of Xiaochang the heavenly step was greatly perilous; the empress dowager disturbed government and the regent state had no lord.
translations.idiomatic: Recently, as Xiaochang closed, the throne's step was dire; the empress dowager threw government into chaos and the regency had no ruler.

sentences.zh: 尒朱榮爰自晉陽，同憂王室，義旗之建，大會盟津，與世樂推，共成鴻業。

translations.literal: Erzhu Rong came from Jinyang sharing worry for the royal house; when the banner of righteousness was raised, a great assembly met at Meng Ford; the age joyfully pushed him forward and together they completed the great enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: Erzhu Rong came from Jinyang with shared grief for the royal house; when the banner of righteousness rose, hosts gathered at Meng Ford; the age gladly pushed him on, and together they built the great work.

sentences.zh: 論其始圖，非無勞效。

translations.literal: Judging his first design, it was not without labor and effect.
translations.idiomatic: In his first intent there was real toil and result.

sentences.zh: 但致遠恐泥，終之實難，曾未崇朝，豺聲已露。

translations.literal: But to reach far yet fear being mired, to finish is in truth hard; before a morning was honored, the jackal's cry was already exposed.
translations.idiomatic: Yet to aim far is to fear sinking in the end—and finishing is hard indeed; before the court could honor him a full morning, his jackal voice was already plain.

sentences.zh: 河陰之役，安忍無親。

translations.literal: At the Heyin campaign he could bear to be without kin.
translations.idiomatic: At Heyin he could slaughter kin without flinching.

sentences.zh: 王公卿士，一朝塗地，宗戚靡遺，內外俱盡。

translations.literal: Kings, dukes, ministers, and gentry perished in a morning; kin within and without were utterly destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Kings, dukes, ministers, and officers died in a single morning; kin inside and outside the house were wiped out.

sentences.zh: 假弄天威，殆危神器。

translations.literal: Borrowing heaven's authority, he nearly endangered the sacred vessel.
translations.idiomatic: Wielding borrowed heavenly mandate, he nearly overturned the sacred vessel.

sentences.zh: 時事倉卒，未遑問罪。

translations.literal: Matters were hurried and there was no leisure to inquire into guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Events rushed on; there was no moment to call him to account.

sentences.zh: 尋以葛賊橫行，馬首南向，捨過責成，用平醜虜。

translations.literal: Soon, because Ge's bandits ran rampant and horse heads turned south, faults were set aside and achievement demanded to pacify the ugly foe.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Ge's rebels ran wild and armies turned south; faults were set aside and success demanded to crush the foul enemy.

sentences.zh: 及元顥問鼎，大駕北巡，復致勤王，展力行所。

translations.literal: When Yuan Hao questioned the tripod and the great carriage toured north, again he roused troops loyal to the throne and showed strength where action was needed.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan Hao seized the tripod and the imperial carriage toured north, again he mustered loyal arms and pressed his strength where the need lay.

sentences.zh: 以此論功，且可補過。

translations.literal: Judging by this merit, it might yet have made up for faults.
translations.idiomatic: Measured by that service alone, one might say his faults were partly redeemed.

sentences.zh: 既位極宰衡，地踰齊、魯，容養之至，豈復是過？

translations.literal: Having already attained the utmost rank of chief minister, with domains surpassing Qi and Lu, could indulgence in nurturing him still be excessive?
translations.idiomatic: Once he stood at the summit of power, with domains exceeding those of Qi and Lu, how could further indulgence still be called going too far?

sentences.zh: 但心如猛火，山林無以供其暴；

translations.literal: But his heart was like fierce fire; mountains and forests could not supply its violence;
translations.idiomatic: Yet his heart blazed like wildfire, and no mountain forest could satisfy its fury;

sentences.zh: 意等漏巵，江河無以充其溢。

translations.literal: his intent was like a leaking cup; rivers and streams could not fill its overflow.
translations.idiomatic: his ambition was like a cup that never holds still—no river could slake its excess.

sentences.zh: 既見金革稍寧，方隅漸泰，不推天功，專為己力，與奪任情，臧否肆意，無君之跡，日月以甚。

translations.literal: When arms and armor had grown somewhat quiet and the regions gradually at peace, he did not extend heaven's achievement but kept it for himself alone; in granting and taking he followed his whim, in praise and blame he acted at will—the traces of one without a lord grew daily more evident.
translations.idiomatic: When war subsided and the realm grew calm again, he claimed heaven's merit as his own; rewards and punishments obeyed his whim, and his lordless conduct grew plainer by the day.

sentences.zh: 拔髮數罪，蓋不足稱；

translations.literal: To count his crimes by plucking hairs would scarcely suffice;
translations.idiomatic: To number his crimes hair by hair would still fall short;

sentences.zh: 斬竹書愆，豈云能盡。

translations.literal: to record his guilt by cutting bamboo could never exhaust it.
translations.idiomatic: and to inscribe his guilt on bamboo slips could never exhaust the list.

sentences.zh: 方復託名朝宗，陰圖釁逆，睥睨天居，窺覦聖曆。

translations.literal: Again he borrowed the name of court orthodoxy while secretly plotting rebellion, casting sidelong glances at the imperial residence and coveting the sacred succession.
translations.idiomatic: Again he cloaked himself in loyalty to the court while plotting treason in secret, eyeing the imperial palace and coveting the throne.

sentences.zh: 乃有裂冠毀冕之心，將為拔本塞源之事。

translations.literal: He harbored a heart to tear the crown and destroy the regalia, and meant to uproot the tree and block the source.
translations.idiomatic: He harbored the will to tear down the crown and regalia and to uproot the dynasty at its source.

sentences.zh: 天既厭亂，人亦悔禍，同惡之臣，密來投告。

translations.literal: Heaven had already grown weary of disorder, and men too repented the calamity; ministers who shared his evil secretly came to report.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven had grown weary of chaos and men repented the disaster; accomplices came forward in secret to denounce him.

sentences.zh: 將而必誅，罪無容捨。

translations.literal: A general who rebels must be executed; his guilt admits no pardon.
translations.idiomatic: A rebel commander must die; his crimes allow no mercy.

sentences.zh: 又元天穆宗室末屬，名望素微，遭逢際會，頗參義舉。

translations.literal: Moreover Yuan Tianmu was a junior branch of the imperial clan, of slight repute by name; meeting with the moment's chance, he took part in the righteous rising.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Tianmu too belonged to a junior line of the house, a man of little standing who had joined the loyal rising when fortune offered the chance.

sentences.zh: 不能竭其忠誠以奉家國，乃復棄本逐末，背同即異，為之謀主，成彼禍心。

translations.literal: He could not exhaust his loyalty to serve the state and kin, but again abandoned the root to chase the branch, turned his back on allies to join the alien side, became their strategist, and completed their wicked design.
translations.idiomatic: He failed to give his full loyalty to throne and clan, turned from the root to chase the branch, betrayed his allies for the enemy, became their strategist, and helped fulfill their treacherous design.

sentences.zh: 是而可忍，孰不可恕！

translations.literal: If this can be borne, what cannot be forgiven!
translations.idiomatic: If this could be tolerated, what crime could not?

sentences.zh: 並以伏辜，自貽伊戚。

translations.literal: Both were executed for their crimes and brought ruin on themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Both were put to death for their crimes and brought calamity on themselves.

sentences.zh: 元惡既除，人神慶泰，便可大赦天下。

translations.literal: The chief villain having been removed, men and spirits rejoiced in peace; a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: With the chief villain gone, men and spirits rejoiced; a general amnesty was proclaimed for all under heaven.

sentences.zh: 遣武衞將軍奚毅、前燕州刺史崔淵率兵鎮北中。

translations.literal: Guard-General of Martial Readiness Xi Yi and former Inspector of Former Yan Province Cui Yuan were dispatched to lead troops and garrison North Zhong.
