translations.idiomatic: Xi Yi, guard-general of martial readiness, and Cui Yuan, former inspector of Former Yan province, were sent with troops to garrison North Zhong.

translations.literal: The text is deficient.
translations.idiomatic: The text is deficient.

sentences.zh: 是夜，僕射尒朱世隆、榮妻鄉郡長公主，率榮部曲焚西陽門，出屯河陰。

translations.literal: That night, Vice Director Erzhu Shilong, Rong's wife the Princess of Xiang Commandery, and others led Rong's troops to burn the Xiyang Gate, went out, and encamped at Heyin.
translations.idiomatic: That night Vice Director Erzhu Shilong, Rong's wife the Princess of Xiang Commandery, and others led Rong's retainers to burn the Xiyang Gate, left the city, and encamped at Heyin.

sentences.zh: 己亥，攻河橋，擒毅等於途，害之，據北中城，南逼京邑。

translations.literal: On jihai day they attacked Hey Bridge, captured Yi and the others on the road and killed them, held North Zhong city, and pressed south on the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai they attacked Hey Bridge, seized Yi and his party on the march and killed them, occupied North Zhong, and pressed the capital from the south.

sentences.zh: 詔以驃騎大將軍、雍州刺史、廣宗郡開國公尒朱天光為侍中、儀同三司，以侍中、司空公楊津為使持節、督并肆燕恒雲朔顯汾蔚九州諸軍事、驃騎大將軍、并州刺史、兼尚書令、北道大行臺，經略并肆。

translations.literal: An edict made Erzhu Tianguang, general of agile cavalry, inspector of Yong Province, and Duke of Guangzong with an open state, director of the Masters of Writing with ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies; and Yang Jin, director of the Masters of Writing and Duke of the State of the Grandee, bearer of the staff of office, commissioner with full powers, commander of the nine provinces Bing, Xi, Yan, Heng, Yun, Shuo, Xian, Fen, and Yu, general of agile cavalry, inspector of Bing Province, and concurrent director of the Masters of Writing, northern-route grand mobile office, to manage Bing and Xi.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Erzhu Tianguang, general of agile cavalry, inspector of Yong province, and duke of Guangzong with an open state, as director of the Masters of Writing with ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies; and Yang Jin, director of the Masters of Writing and state grandee, bearer of the staff of office, as commissioner with full powers over Bing, Xi, Yan, Heng, Yun, Shuo, Xian, Fen, and Yu, general of agile cavalry, inspector of Bing province, concurrent director of the Masters of Writing, and northern-route grand mobile office, to manage Bing and Xi.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔諸舊代人赴華林園，帝將親簡叙。

translations.literal: On gengzi day an edict ordered all men of the old Xianbei registration to come to Hualin Park; the emperor would personally review and assign them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi an edict summoned all men of the old Xianbei registration to Hualin Park for the emperor's personal review.

sentences.zh: 以撫軍將軍、金紫光祿大夫高乾邕為侍中、河北大使，招集驍勇。

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the Army and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Gao Qianyong was made director of the Masters of Writing and grand envoy of Hebei, to gather fierce warriors.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Qianyong, general who pacifies the army and grand master of splendid happiness, was made director of the Masters of Writing and grand envoy of Hebei to gather fierce warriors.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸卯朔，封安南將軍、大鴻臚卿元寶炬為南陽王，大宗正卿、汝陽縣開國公元脩為平陽王，通直散騎常侍、龍驤將軍、新陽縣開國伯元誕為昌樂王。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, new moon on guimao day: General Who Pacifies the South and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Yuan Baoju was enfeoffed as Prince of Nanyang; Grand Director of the Imperial Clan and Duke of Ruyang with an open state Yuan Xiu as Prince of Pingyang; Regular Attendant and General of the Dragon Cavalry Yuan Dan, Baron of Xinyang with an open state, as Prince of Changle.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the guimao new moon, Yuan Baoju, general who pacifies the south and grand master of splendid happiness, was enfeoffed as prince of Nanyang; Yuan Xiu, grand director of the imperial clan and duke of Ruyang with an open state, as prince of Pingyang; and Yuan Dan, regular attendant and general of the dragon cavalry, baron of Xinyang with an open state, as prince of Changle.

sentences.zh: 復通直散騎常侍、琅邪縣開國公。

translations.literal: Again restored Regular Attendant and Duke of Langye with an open state.
translations.idiomatic: Regular Attendant and Duke of Langye with an open state were also restored.

sentences.zh: 李叔仁官爵，[12]仍為使持節、大都督，以討世隆。

translations.literal: Li Shuren's office and rank, [12] and he remained commissioner with full powers and grand commander to attack Shilong.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shuren's office and rank [12] were restored, and he remained commissioner with full powers and grand commander to attack Shilong.

sentences.zh: 以魏郡王諶徙封趙郡王，諶弟子趙郡王寘改封平昌王。

translations.literal: Prince of Wei Commandery Chen was transferred to Prince of Zhao Commandery; Chen's nephew, Prince of Zhao Commandery Zhi, was changed to Prince of Pingchang.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Wei Commandery Chen was re-enfeoffed as prince of Zhao Commandery; his nephew Zhi, prince of Zhao Commandery, was made prince of Pingchang instead.

sentences.zh: 儀同三司李虔薨。

translations.literal: Bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies Li Qian died.
translations.idiomatic: Li Qian, bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies, died.

sentences.zh: 丁未，班募攻河橋格，賞帛授官各有差。

translations.literal: On dingwei day recruitment placards for attacking Hey Bridge were issued; rewards in silk and appointment to office varied by rank.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei recruitment placards for the assault on Hey Bridge were posted, with graded rewards in silk and offices.

sentences.zh: 戊申，皇子生，大赦天下，文武百僚汎二級。

translations.literal: On wushen day a prince was born; a general amnesty was proclaimed, and civil and military officials of the hundred offices all received two grades of promotion.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen a prince was born; a general amnesty was proclaimed and every civil and military official received two grades of promotion.

sentences.zh: 以平南將軍、中書令魏蘭根兼尚書左僕射，為河北行臺，定相殷三州禀蘭根節度。

translations.literal: Pacification-General of the South and Director of the Masters of Writing Wei Langen was made concurrent left vice director of the Masters of Writing and Hebei mobile office; Ding, Xiang, and Yin provinces were placed under Langen's command.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Langen, pacification-general of the south and director of the Masters of Writing, was made concurrent left vice director and Hebei mobile office commander; Ding, Xiang, and Yin provinces were placed under his command.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，通直散騎常侍、假平西將軍、都督李苗以火船焚河橋，尒朱世隆退走。

translations.literal: On yimao day Regular Attendant and Acting Pacification-General of the West and Commander Li Miao burned Hey Bridge with fire-ships; Erzhu Shilong withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Li Miao, regular attendant, acting pacification-general of the west, and commander, burned Hey Bridge with fire-ships and Erzhu Shilong retreated.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔大都督、兼尚書僕射、行臺源子恭率步騎一萬出自西道，行臺楊昱領都督李侃希等部募勇士八千往從東路，防討之。

translations.literal: On bingchen day an edict ordered Grand Commander and Concurrent Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Mobile Office Yuan Zigong to lead ten thousand foot and horse out by the western route; Mobile Office Yang Yu to lead Commander Li Kanxi and others' levies of eight thousand brave men by the eastern route, to defend and attack them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen an edict ordered Yuan Zigong, grand commander, concurrent vice director, and mobile office commander, to lead ten thousand foot and horse by the western route; Yang Yu of the mobile office to lead Li Kanxi and other commanders' levies of eight thousand brave men by the eastern route, to defend and attack them.

sentences.zh: 子恭仍鎮太行丹谷。

translations.literal: Zigong still garrisoned Dangu of Mount Taihang.
translations.idiomatic: Zigong continued to garrison Dangu on Mount Taihang.

sentences.zh: 世隆至建州，刺史陸希質拒守，城陷，盡屠之，唯希質獲免。

translations.literal: Shilong reached Jian Province; Inspector Lu Xizhi held out in defense; the city fell and all were slaughtered, only Xizhi being spared.
translations.idiomatic: Shilong reached Jian province; Inspector Lu Xizhi defended the city; when it fell the population was slaughtered, Xizhi alone being spared.

sentences.zh: 以中軍將軍、前東荊州刺史元顯恭為使持節、都督晉建南汾三州諸軍事、鎮西將軍、晉州刺史、兼尚書左僕射，為征西道行臺，[13]節度都督薛善樂、薛修義、裴元儁、薛崇禮、薛憘族等。

translations.literal: General of the Center Army and former Inspector of East Jing Province Yuan Xiangong was made commissioner with full powers, commander of the three provinces Jin, Jian, and South Fen, Pacification-General of the West, inspector of Jin Province, and concurrent left vice director of the Masters of Writing, western-campaign-route grand mobile office, [13] commanding the supervisors Xue Shanle, Xue Xiuyi, Pei Yuanjun, Xue Chongli, Xue Xizu, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Xiangong, general of the center army and former inspector of East Jing province, was made commissioner with full powers over Jin, Jian, and South Fen, pacification-general of the west, inspector of Jin province, concurrent left vice director, and western-campaign-route grand mobile office, [13] with command over Xue Shanle, Xue Xiuyi, Pei Yuanjun, Xue Chongli, Xue Xizu, and the other supervisors.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔以世隆北叛，河內固守，其在城督將文武普加二級，兵士給復三年。

translations.literal: On dingmao day an edict stated that because Shilong had rebelled in the north and Heyin was held firm in defense, all commanders, generals, civil and military officials in the city should receive two grades of promotion, and soldiers three years' exemption from corvée.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao an edict declared that because Shilong had rebelled in the north while Heyin held firm, every commander, general, and civil or military official in the city should receive two grades of promotion and soldiers three years' exemption from corvée.

sentences.zh: 壬申，尒朱世隆停建興之高都，尒朱兆自晉陽來會之，共推太原太守、行并州刺史長廣王曄為主，大赦所部，號年建明，普汎四級。

translations.literal: On renshen day Erzhu Shilong halted at Gaodu of Jianxing; Erzhu Zhao came from Jinyang to join him; together they made Taiyuan Administrator and acting Inspector of Bing Province Yuan Ye, Prince of Changguang, their leader, proclaimed a general amnesty in their territory, era name Jianming, and a universal promotion of four grades.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Erzhu Shilong halted at Gaodu in Jianxing; Erzhu Zhao came from Jinyang to join him; together they set Yuan Ye, prince of Changguang, who was Taiyuan administrator and acting inspector of Bing province, at their head, proclaimed a general amnesty in their territory, era name Jianming, and a universal promotion of four grades.

sentences.zh: 徐州刺史尒朱仲遠反，率眾向京師。

translations.literal: Inspector of Xu Province Erzhu Zhongyuan rebelled and led his host toward the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Erzhu Zhongyuan, inspector of Xu province, rebelled and marched his army toward the capital.

sentences.zh: 十有一月癸酉朔，詔車騎將軍、左衞將軍鄭先護為使持節、大將軍、大都督，與都督李侃希赴行臺楊昱以討之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, new moon on guiyou day: an edict made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Left Guard-General Zheng Xianhu commissioner with full powers, grand general, and grand commander, to go with Commander Li Kanxi to Mobile Office Yang Yu to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the guiyou new moon, an edict made Zheng Xianhu, general of chariots and cavalry and left guard-general, commissioner with full powers, grand general, and grand commander, to go with Li Kanxi to Yang Yu's mobile office to attack him.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以使持節、兼尚書令、西道大行臺、司徒公長孫稚為太尉公，侍中、尚書令、驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、臨淮王彧為司徒公。

translations.literal: On yihai day Bearer of the Staff of Office, Concurrent Director of the Masters of Writing, Western-Route Grand Mobile Office, and Duke of the State of the Grandee Changsun Zhi was made Duke of the Grandee; Director of the Masters of Writing, General of Agile Cavalry, Opener of the Office with ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies, and Prince of Huaiyang Yu was made Duke of the State of the Grandee.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Changsun Zhi, bearer of the staff of office, concurrent director of the Masters of Writing, western-route grand mobile office, and state grandee, was made grand duke; and Yu, prince of Huaiyang, director of the Masters of Writing, general of agile cavalry, and opener of the office with ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies, was made state grandee.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以驃騎大將軍、儀同三司、雍州刺史、廣宗郡開國公尒朱天光開府，進爵為王。

translations.literal: On bingzi day Erzhu Tianguang, general of agile cavalry, bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies, inspector of Yong Province, and Duke of Guangzong with an open state, opened an office and was advanced in rank to prince.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Erzhu Tianguang, general of agile cavalry, bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies, inspector of Yong province, and duke of Guangzong with an open state, opened an office and was advanced to prince.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，尒朱仲遠陷西兗州，執刺史王衍。

translations.literal: On dingchou day Erzhu Zhongyuan took West Yan Province and seized Inspector Wang Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Erzhu Zhongyuan took West Yan province and seized Wang Yan, inspector.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以右衞將軍賀拔勝為東征都督。

translations.literal: On guiwei day Right Guard-General Heluo Sheng was made eastern-expedition commander.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Heluo Sheng, right guard-general, was made eastern-expedition commander.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，又以左衞將軍、大都督鄭先護兼尚書左僕射，為行臺，與勝並討仲遠。

translations.literal: On renchen day Left Guard-General and Grand Commander Zheng Xianhu was also made concurrent left vice director of the Masters of Writing and mobile office commander, to join Sheng in attacking Zhongyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Zheng Xianhu, left guard-general and grand commander, was also made concurrent left vice director and mobile office commander to join Sheng in attacking Zhongyuan.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔罷魏蘭根行臺，以後將軍、定州刺史薛曇尚為使持節、兼尚書，為北道行臺，隨機召發。

translations.literal: On wuxu day an edict abolished Wei Langen's mobile office; Rear-General and Inspector of Ding Province Xue Tanshang was made commissioner with full powers and concurrent director of the Masters of Writing, northern-route mobile office, to levy troops as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu an edict abolished Wei Langen's mobile office; Xue Tanshang, rear-general and inspector of Ding province, was made commissioner with full powers, concurrent director of the Masters of Writing, and northern-route mobile office commander, to levy troops as needed.

sentences.zh: 行豫州刺史元崇禮殺後行州事陰導和，擅攝豫州。

translations.literal: Acting Inspector of Yu Province Yuan Chongli killed the later acting provincial officer Yin Daohe and seized Yu Province on his own authority.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Chongli, acting inspector of Yu province, killed Yin Daohe, who had been acting in provincial affairs, and seized Yu province on his own authority.

sentences.zh: 庚子，賀拔勝與仲遠戰於滑臺東，失利，仍奔之。

translations.literal: On gengzi day Heluo Sheng fought Zhongyuan east of Huatai, was defeated, and then fled to join him.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Heluo Sheng fought Zhongyuan east of Huatai, was defeated, and then went over to his side.

sentences.zh: 十有二月壬寅朔，尒朱兆寇丹谷，都督崔伯鳳戰歿，都督羊文義、史五龍降兆，大都督源子恭奔退。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon on renyin day: Erzhu Zhao raided Dangu; Supervisor Cui Bofeng died in battle; Supervisors Yang Wenyi and Shi Wulong surrendered to Zhao; Grand Commander Yuan Zigong fled in retreat.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the renyin new moon, Erzhu Zhao raided Dangu; Cui Bofeng, supervisor, was killed in battle; Yang Wenyi and Shi Wulong, supervisors, surrendered to Zhao; Yuan Zigong, grand commander, fled.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，尒朱兆、尒朱度律自富平津上，率騎涉渡，以襲京城。

translations.literal: On jiachen day Erzhu Zhao and Erzhu Dulü from Fuping Ford upstream led cavalry across the ford to strike the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Erzhu Zhao and Erzhu Dulü crossed from Fuping Ford upstream with cavalry to strike the capital.

sentences.zh: 事出倉卒，禁衞不守。

translations.literal: The affair arose in sudden haste; the palace guard could not hold.
translations.idiomatic: Caught by sudden crisis, the palace guard could not hold.

sentences.zh: 帝出雲龍門。

translations.literal: The emperor went out through the Cloud Dragon Gate.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor fled out through the Cloud Dragon Gate.

sentences.zh: 兆逼帝幸永寧佛寺，殺皇子，并殺司徒公、臨淮王彧，左僕射、范陽王誨。

translations.literal: Zhao forced the emperor to go to Yongning Buddhist Temple, killed the prince, and also killed Duke of the State of the Grandee and Prince of Huaiyang Yu and left vice director and Prince of Fanyang Hui.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao forced the emperor to Yongning Buddhist Temple, killed the prince, and also killed Yu, state grandee and prince of Huaiyang, and Hui, left vice director and prince of Fanyang.

sentences.zh: 戊申，元曄大赦天下。

translations.literal: On wushen day Yuan Ye proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Yuan Ye proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 尒朱度律自鎮京師。

translations.literal: Erzhu Dulü himself garrisoned the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Erzhu Dulü took personal command of the capital garrison.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，尒朱兆遷帝於晉陽；

translations.literal: On jiayin day Erzhu Zhao moved the emperor to Jinyang;
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Erzhu Zhao moved the emperor to Jinyang;

sentences.zh: 甲子，崩於城內三級佛寺，時年二十四。

translations.literal: on jiazi day he died in the Three-Tier Buddhist Temple within the city, aged twenty-four.
translations.idiomatic: on jiazi he died in the Three-Tier Buddhist Temple within the city. He was twenty-four.

sentences.zh: 并害陳留王寬。

translations.literal: Prince of Chenliu Kuan was also killed.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Chenliu Kuan was killed as well.

sentences.zh: 是月，河西人紇豆陵步蕃、破落韓常大敗尒朱兆於秀容。

translations.literal: That month Hedouling Bufan of Hexi and Poluo Hanchang greatly defeated Erzhu Zhao at Xiurong.
translations.idiomatic: That month Hedouling Bufan of Hexi and Poluo Hanchang routed Erzhu Zhao at Xiurong.

sentences.zh: 齊州城人趙洛周據西城反，應尒朱兆，刺史、丹陽王蕭贊棄城走。

translations.literal: The townsman Zhao Luozhou of Qi Province held the west city in rebellion in response to Erzhu Zhao; Inspector and Prince of Danyang Xiao Zan abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Luozhou of Qi province seized the west city in rebellion in support of Erzhu Zhao; Xiao Zan, inspector and prince of Danyang, abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 南陽太守趙脩延執荊州刺史李琰之，自行州事。

translations.literal: Administrator of Nanyang Zhao Xiuyan seized Inspector of Jing Province Li Yanzhi and acted as provincial governor himself.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Xiuyan, administrator of Nanyang, seized Li Yanzhi, inspector of Jing province, and acted as provincial governor himself.

sentences.zh: 中興二年諡為武懷皇帝，太昌元年又諡孝莊皇帝，廟號敬宗。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhongxing he was given the posthumous title Emperor Wu Huai; in the first year of Taichang he was again given the posthumous title Emperor Xiaozhuang, temple name Jingzong.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhongxing year 2 he received the posthumous title Emperor Wu Huai; in Taichang year 1 he was again given Emperor Xiaozhuang, with temple name Jingzong.

sentences.zh: 十一月，葬於靜陵。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he was buried at Jing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he was interred at Jing Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：魏自孝昌之末，天下淆然，外侮內亂，神器固將無主。

translations.literal: The historian says: From the end of the Xiaochang era in Wei, the realm was in turmoil; foreign insult and internal disorder alike showed that the sacred vessel would soon lack a lord.
translations.idiomatic: The historian writes: From the close of the Xiaochang era the Wei realm was in turmoil; foreign raids and civil war alike showed that the throne would soon stand empty.

sentences.zh: 莊帝潛思變化，招納勤王，雖時事孔棘，而卒有四海。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhuang secretly planned change, recruited men to restore the throne, and though the times were desperately hard, in the end he held the four seas.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhuang secretly planned reform, rallied loyal armies, and though the times were desperate, in the end he held the realm.

sentences.zh: 猾逆既翦，權強擅命，抑是兆謀運智之秋，勞謙夕惕之日也。

translations.literal: When the treacherous rebels had been cut down, the powerful usurped command—this should have been the season for Zhao to plot and exercise wisdom, for labor and modest vigilance evening and morning.
translations.idiomatic: When the traitors were cut down, the mighty seized command—this should have been the hour for careful counsel and modest vigilance day and night.

sentences.zh: 未聞長轡之策，遽深負刺之恐，謀謨罕術，授任乖方，猜嫌行戮，禍不旋踵。

translations.literal: No long-rein policy was heard of; suddenly deep fear of being stabbed in the back arose; counsel was rare and art lacking, appointments went to the wrong men, suspicion led to executions, and calamity followed without pause.
translations.idiomatic: He heard no counsel for holding the reins long; suspicion and executions followed one another, appointments went awry, and disaster came without respite.

sentences.zh: 嗚呼！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 胡醜之為釁也，豈周衰晉末而已哉！

translations.literal: That the Hu barbarians should become a scourge—was it only in the decline of Zhou and the end of Jin!
translations.idiomatic: That the Hu should become a scourge—was it only in Zhou's decline and Jin's end!

sentences.zh: 至於高祖不祀，武宣享廟，三后降鑒，福祿固不永矣。

translations.literal: As for Gaozu going un-sacrificed and Wuxuan enjoying the temple, the three empresses descending to witness—all showed that fortune and blessing would not long endure.
translations.idiomatic: When Gaozu went unsacrificed and Wuxuan received the temple, and the three empresses bore witness from on high, fortune could not long endure.

sentences.zh: 校勘記

translations.literal: Collation notes
translations.idiomatic: Collation notes

sentences.zh: 趙郡王毓 諸本「毓」作「敏」。

translations.literal: Prince of Zhao Commandery Yu: in all editions "Yu" is written "Min."
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Zhao Commandery Yu: every edition writes "Yu" as "Min."

sentences.zh: 按卷二一趙郡王幹傳稱：「子毓，字子春，莊帝初，河陰遇害。

translations.literal: Comment: the Biography of Prince of Zhao Commandery Gan in juan 21, part 1, states: "His son Yu, styled Zichun, at the beginning of Emperor Zhuang's reign met disaster at Heyin."
translations.idiomatic: The Biography of Prince of Zhao Commandery Gan in juan 21, part 1, reads: "His son Yu, styled Zichun, at the beginning of Emperor Zhuang's reign met disaster at Heyin."

sentences.zh: 」漢魏南北朝墓誌集釋

translations.literal: Han-Wei-Northern Dynasties tomb epitaphs collected and explained
translations.idiomatic: Han-Wei-Northern Dynasties Tomb Epitaphs: Collected and Explained

sentences.zh: 〈下簡稱墓誌集釋〉

translations.literal: (hereafter abbreviated Tomb Epitaphs Collected)
translations.idiomatic: (abbreviated Tomb Epitaphs Collected)

sentences.zh: 有元毓墓誌

translations.literal: contains the epitaph of Yuan Yu
translations.idiomatic: contains the epitaph of Yuan Yu

sentences.zh: 〈圖版一七三之二〉

translations.literal: (plate 173, no. 2)
translations.idiomatic: (plate 173, no. 2)

sentences.zh: ，即此人。

translations.literal: —this is the man.
translations.idiomatic: —this is the man in question.

sentences.zh: 「毓」和「春」名字相應，「敏」乃形近而訛，今改正。

translations.literal: "Yu" and "Chun" in the name correspond; "Min" is a graphic corruption from similarity of form—now emended.
translations.idiomatic: "Yu" pairs with "Chun" in the name; "Min" is a graphic corruption from similar forms—emended here.

sentences.zh: 襲爵泰臨縣開國伯 百衲本和南、北、局本「泰」都作「秦」，汲本又訛作「奏」，殿本據卷一０一高昌傳

translations.literal: succeeded to the rank of Baron of Tailin with an open state: in the Baina, Southern, Northern, and Bureau editions "Tai" is all written "Qin"; the Jibu edition further corrupts it to "Zou"; the Palace edition according to juan 101 Biography of Gaochang
translations.idiomatic: Succeeded as baron of Tailin with an open state: in the Baina, Southern, Northern, and Bureau editions "Tai" is written "Qin" throughout; the Jibu edition corrupts it further to "Zou"; the Palace edition follows juan 101, Biography of Gaochang,

translations.literal: (supplement)
translations.idiomatic: (supplement)

sentences.zh: 改「泰」。

translations.literal: to emend "Tai."
translations.idiomatic: to emend "Tai."

sentences.zh: 按北史卷五元本

translations.literal: Comment: Beishi juan 5 Yuan version
translations.idiomatic: Beishi juan 5, Yuan version,

sentences.zh: 〈百衲本的底本〉

translations.literal: (the base text of the Baina edition)
translations.idiomatic: (base text of the Baina edition)

sentences.zh: 和南、北監本也作「秦」，百衲本依殿本改「泰」。

translations.literal: and the Southern and Northern Directorate editions also read "Qin"; the Baina edition according to the Palace edition emended "Tai."
translations.idiomatic: and the Southern and Northern Directorate editions also read "Qin"; the Baina edition follows the Palace edition in reading "Tai."

sentences.zh: 按本傳作「泰」，卷一一出帝紀永熙二年十月條也作「泰」，今從殿本。

translations.literal: Comment: this biography reads "Tai," and the entry for the tenth month of the second year of Yongxi in juan 11 Annals of the Deposed Emperor also reads "Tai"—now follow the Palace edition.
translations.idiomatic: This biography reads "Tai," and the Yongxi year 2, tenth-month entry in juan 11, Annals of the Deposed Emperor, also reads "Tai"—the Palace reading is followed here.

sentences.zh: 軍級從三品以上從征四品者優一大階 冊府卷六二

translations.literal: military grade from third rank and above, and those on campaign from fourth rank, receive one major grade of preferment: Cefu juan 62
translations.idiomatic: Military grade from third rank and above and those on campaign from fourth rank receive one major grade of preferment: Cefu juan 62

sentences.zh: 「從征」下無「四品」二字。

translations.literal: under "on campaign" there are no characters "fourth rank."
translations.idiomatic: under "on campaign" the words "fourth rank" do not appear.

sentences.zh: 按有「四品」二字，文義晦澀，疑衍，或「從征」下有脫文。

translations.literal: Comment: with the characters "fourth rank" present the sense is obscure—suspected interpolation, or there is lacuna under "on campaign."
translations.idiomatic: With "fourth rank" present the sense is obscure—likely an interpolation, or text is missing after "on campaign."

sentences.zh: 是月 按上已見「是月」，不應重出，疑衍。

translations.literal: that month: Comment: "that month" already appears above and should not recur—suspected interpolation.
translations.idiomatic: "That month": "that month" already appears above and should not recur—likely an interpolation.

sentences.zh: 太山太守羊侃據郡引蕭衍將軍王辯攻兗州 諸本「王辯」作「王僧辯」。

translations.literal: Administrator of Mount Tai Yang Kan held the commandery and led Liang general Wang Bian to attack Yan Province: in all editions "Wang Bian" is written "Wang Sengbian."
translations.idiomatic: Yang Kan, administrator of Mount Tai, held the commandery and led Liang general Wang Bian against Yan province: all editions write "Wang Bian" as "Wang Sengbian."

sentences.zh: 按卷五八楊昱傳敍此事作「王辯」，梁書卷三三羊侃傳稱侃降梁後，「遣羊鴉仁、王弁率軍迎接」。

translations.literal: Comment: the Biography of Yang Yu in juan 58 narrates this affair as "Wang Bian"; the Biography of Yang Kan in Liang shu juan 33 states that after Kan surrendered to Liang, "he sent Yang Yaren and Wang Ban to lead troops to meet him."
translations.idiomatic: The Biography of Yang Yu in juan 58 gives "Wang Bian"; Liang shu juan 33, Biography of Yang Kan, says that after Kan surrendered to Liang he "sent Yang Yaren and Wang Ban to lead troops to meet him."

sentences.zh: 顯然「王辯」或「王弁」即此紀的「王僧辯」。

translations.literal: Clearly "Wang Bian" or "Wang Ban" is this annal's "Wang Sengbian."
translations.idiomatic: Clearly "Wang Bian" or "Wang Ban" in those texts is this annal's "Wang Sengbian."

sentences.zh: 王辯又屢見卷二一下彭城王勰附元劭傳、卷七九鹿悆傳等。

translations.literal: "Wang Bian" also appears repeatedly in juan 21, part 2, Biography of Prince of Pengcheng Xie with appended Biography of Yuan Shao, juan 79 Biography of Lu Yue, and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: "Wang Bian" also appears repeatedly in juan 21, part 2 (Biography of Prince of Pengcheng Xie, appended Biography of Yuan Shao), juan 79 (Biography of Lu Yue), and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 查梁書卷四五王僧辯傳不載此事。

translations.literal: Examination shows that the Biography of Wang Sengbian in Liang shu juan 45 does not record this affair.
translations.idiomatic: The Biography of Wang Sengbian in Liang shu juan 45 does not record this affair.

sentences.zh: 本傳說湘東王繹為荊州刺史，他就在蕭繹手下做官。

translations.literal: That biography states that when Xiao Yi, Prince of Xiangdong, was inspector of Jing Province, Sengbian served under Xiao Yi.
translations.idiomatic: That biography says that when Xiao Yi, prince of Xiangdong, was inspector of Jing province, Sengbian served under him.

sentences.zh: 據梁書卷五元帝紀，蕭繹第一次任荊州刺史是從普通七年

translations.literal: According to the Annals of Emperor Yuan in Liang shu juan 5, Xiao Yi's first appointment as inspector of Jing Province was from the seventh year of Putong
translations.idiomatic: Liang shu juan 5, Annals of Emperor Yuan, records Xiao Yi's first appointment as inspector of Jing province from Putong year 7

sentences.zh: 〈五二六〉
到大同五年

translations.literal: to the fifth year of Datong
translations.idiomatic: through Datong year 5

sentences.zh: 〈五三九〉
，則本年大通二年

translations.literal: , then in this year, the second year of Datong
translations.idiomatic: , so in Datong year 2

sentences.zh: 〈五二八〉
，王僧辯正在荊州。

translations.literal: Wang Sengbian was in Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Sengbian was in Jing province.

sentences.zh: 這裏本同楊昱傳作「王辯」，也即梁書的「王弁」，後人妄增「僧」字，今刪。

translations.literal: Here the main text agrees with the Biography of Yang Yu as "Wang Bian," that is Liang shu's "Wang Ban"; later men groundlessly added the character "Seng"—now deleted.
translations.idiomatic: The main text here agrees with Yang Yu's biography as "Wang Bian," i.e. Liang shu's "Wang Ban"; later copyists groundlessly added "Seng"—removed here.

sentences.zh: 柱國大將軍尒朱榮率騎七萬討葛榮於滏口 南、北、殿三本「萬」作「千」，百衲本、汲本、局本和冊府卷一二一

translations.literal: Grand Commander Erzhu Rong led seventy thousand cavalry to attack Ge Rong at Fukou: in the Southern, Northern, and Palace editions "ten thousand" is written "thousand"; the Baina, Jibu, Bureau editions and Cefu juan 121
translations.idiomatic: Grand commander Erzhu Rong led seventy thousand cavalry against Ge Rong at Fukou: the Southern, Northern, and Palace editions write "ten thousand" as "thousand"; the Baina, Jibu, Bureau editions and Cefu juan 121

sentences.zh: 〈一四五二頁〉
作「萬」。

translations.literal: read "ten thousand."
translations.idiomatic: read "ten thousand."

sentences.zh: 按通鑑卷一五二

translations.literal: Comment: Zizhi tongjian juan 152
translations.idiomatic: Zizhi tongjian juan 152

sentences.zh: 〈四七五一頁〉
作「千」，胡注：「魏收魏書云：『帥騎七萬』。

translations.literal: reads "thousand"; Hu's note: "Wei Shou's Wei shu states: 'led cavalry seventy thousand.'"
translations.idiomatic: has "thousand"; Hu Annotates: "Wei Shou's Wei shu says, 'led cavalry seventy thousand.'"

sentences.zh: 」則舊本此紀自作「萬」。

translations.literal: Thus the old text of this annal itself read "ten thousand."
translations.idiomatic: Thus the old text of this annal read "ten thousand."

sentences.zh: 通鑑這條採自卷七四尒朱榮傳，故作「千」。

translations.literal: This Tongjian entry was taken from juan 74 Biography of Erzhu Rong, hence "thousand."
translations.idiomatic: This Tongjian entry comes from juan 74, Biography of Erzhu Rong, hence "thousand."

sentences.zh: 南本以下各本也都是據傳改。

translations.literal: The Southern edition and all editions below likewise followed the biography in emending.
translations.idiomatic: Southern edition and later editions all followed the biography in emending.

sentences.zh: 這是紀、傳異文，未必傳必是，紀必非。

translations.literal: This is a discrepancy between annal and biography; it is not certain that the biography must be right and the annal wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Annal and biography disagree here; the biography is not necessarily correct and the annal wrong.

sentences.zh: 今從百衲本。

translations.literal: Now follow the Baina edition.
translations.idiomatic: The Baina reading is followed here.

sentences.zh: 北來軍士及隨駕文武馬渚立義 諸本「馬渚」二字作「諸」，冊府卷七九

translations.literal: northern soldiers and civil and military officials accompanying the imperial progress who raised the righteous cause at Mazhu: in all editions the two characters "Mazhu" are written "various"; Cefu juan 79
translations.idiomatic: Northern soldiers and civil and military officials accompanying the imperial progress who raised the righteous cause at Mazhu: all editions write the two characters "Mazhu" as "various"; Cefu juan 79

sentences.zh: 〈九一九頁〉
作「馬渚」。

translations.literal: reads "Mazhu."
translations.idiomatic: reads "Mazhu."

sentences.zh: 按尒朱兆等進攻元顥的軍隊在馬渚渡河，歷見卷七五尒朱兆傳、卷五八楊侃傳。

translations.literal: Comment: the armies of Erzhu Zhao and others attacking Yuan Hao crossed at Mazhu—seen repeatedly in juan 75 Biography of Erzhu Zhao and juan 58 Biography of Yang Kan.
translations.idiomatic: Erzhu Zhao's army and others attacking Yuan Hao crossed at Mazhu—repeatedly attested in juan 75 (Biography of Erzhu Zhao) and juan 58 (Biography of Yang Kan).

sentences.zh: 周書卷三四楊𢷋傳說元顥入洛，「詔𢷋率其宗人，收船馬渚」，以後尒朱兆率軍渡河，就用這批船。

translations.literal: Zhou shu juan 34, Biography of Yang Kan, states that when Yuan Hao entered Luoyang, "an edict ordered Kan to lead his clansmen to gather boats at Mazhu"; afterward when Erzhu Zhao led his army across the river, these boats were used.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou shu juan 34, Biography of Yang Kan, says that when Yuan Hao entered Luoyang, "an edict ordered Kan to lead his clansmen to gather boats at Mazhu"; when Erzhu Zhao later crossed the river, he used those boats.

sentences.zh: 「馬渚立義」即指楊𢷋這些幫助渡河的人。

translations.literal: "Raised the righteous cause at Mazhu" refers to these men who helped with the crossing.
translations.idiomatic: "Raised the righteous cause at Mazhu" refers to Kan and those who helped with the crossing.

sentences.zh: 這次賞格分別等級，「北來軍士」、「隨駕文武」和「馬渚立義」是第一等，下面「河北執事之官」、「河南立義」等等為第二等，都具體指出某地、某事。
